<script>
"use strict";

const $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);
const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat();
const nf1 = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
const nf2 = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(undefined, { numeric: "auto" });
const esc = (v) => String(v ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));

const state = {
  decisions: [], total: 0, offset: 0, pageSize: 20, status: "",
  selectedId: null, detail: null, engineering: null, engineeringError: null,
  verification: null,
};

async function api(url, opts) {
  let res;
  try { res = await fetch(url, opts); }
  catch { throw new Error("Cannot reach the server."); }
  const text = await res.text();
  let body;
  try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = { detail: text || res.statusText }; }
  if (!res.ok) {
    let d = body && body.detail;
    if (d && typeof d !== "string") d = JSON.stringify(d);
    throw new Error(`Server ${res.status}: ${d || "request failed"}`);
  }
  return { body, headers: res.headers };
}

function timeAgo(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d)) return "—";
  const s = Math.round((Date.now() - d) / 1000);
  for (const [u, sec] of [["day", 86400], ["hour", 3600], ["minute", 60]]) {
    if (Math.abs(s) >= sec) return rtf.format(-Math.round(s / sec), u);
  }
  return "just now";
}

function statusPill(status) {
  const cls = status === "APPROVE" ? "ok" : status === "REJECT" ? "alert" : status === "REVIEW" ? "warn" : "neutral";
  return `<span class="pill ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
}

function severityPill(severity) {
  const cls = severity === "OK" ? "ok"
    : severity === "WARNING" ? "warn"
    : (severity === "RESERVE_VIOLATION" || severity === "PHYSICAL_VIOLATION") ? "alert"
    : "neutral";
  return `<span class="pill ${cls}">${esc(severity)}</span>`;
}

function fnum(v, unit) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || (typeof v === "number" && Number.isNaN(v))) {
    return '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>';
  }
  const u = unit ? ` <span class="muted">${esc(unit)}</span>` : "";
  return `${nf2.format(v)}${u}`;
}

function fp(s) {
  if (!s) return '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>';
  return `<code title="${esc(s)}">${esc(s.slice(0, 20))}…</code>`;
}

function splitConstraints(constraints) {
  const elec = constraints.filter((c) => c.name === "electrical");
  const cool = constraints.filter((c) => c.name === "cooling");
  return {
    current: [elec[0], cool[0]].filter(Boolean),
    predicted: [elec[1], cool[1]].filter(Boolean),
  };
}

/* ---- Overview ---- */
function renderStats(s) {
  $("#stat-total").textContent = nf.format(s.total);
  $("#stat-approve").textContent = nf.format(s.approved);
  $("#stat-reject").textContent = nf.format(s.rejected);
  $("#stat-review").textContent = nf.format(s.review);
  renderLatest(s.latest_decision);
  renderRecent(s.recent_activity);
}

function renderLatest(latest) {
  const el = $("#latest-container");
  if (!latest) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="msg empty">No decisions recorded yet.</p>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="latest" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Open latest decision"
         onclick="selectDecision('${esc(latest.id)}')"
         onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();selectDecision('${esc(latest.id)}')}">
      <div>
        <div class="latest-id">${esc(latest.id.slice(0, 12))}…</div>
        <div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem">${esc(timeAgo(latest.created_at))}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="latest-id">config <code>${esc(latest.config_version)}</code> · engine <code>${esc(latest.engine_version)}</code></div>
      <div>${statusPill(latest.status)}</div>
    </div>`;
}

function renderRecent(items) {
  const ul = $("#recent-list");
  if (!items || !items.length) {
    ul.innerHTML = '<li class="msg empty" style="display:block">No recent activity.</li>';
    return;
  }
  ul.innerHTML = items.map((d) => `
    <li tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Open decision ${esc(d.id)}"
        onclick="selectDecision('${esc(d.id)}')"
        onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();selectDecision('${esc(d.id)}')}">
      ${statusPill(d.status)}
      <span class="hid">${esc(d.id.slice(0, 10))}…</span>
      <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem">${esc(d.precedence)}</span>
      <span class="when">${esc(timeAgo(d.created_at))}</span>
    </li>`).join("");
}

function renderHistory() {
  const ul = $("#history-list");
  if (!state.decisions.length) {
    ul.innerHTML = '<li class="msg empty" style="display:block">No decisions match this filter.</li>';
    $("#history-pager").hidden = true;
    return;
  }
  ul.innerHTML = state.decisions.map((d) => `
    <li tabindex="0" role="button" data-id="${esc(d.id)}"
        class="${state.selectedId === d.id ? "selected" : ""}"
        aria-label="Open decision ${esc(d.id)}"
        onclick="selectDecision('${esc(d.id)}')"
        onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();selectDecision('${esc(d.id)}')}">
      ${statusPill(d.status)}
      <span class="hid">${esc(d.id.slice(0, 10))}…${d.is_superseded ? " · superseded" : ""}</span>
      <span class="cv">${esc(d.config_version)}</span>
      <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem">${esc(d.precedence)}</span>
      <span class="when">${esc(timeAgo(d.created_at))}</span>
    </li>`).join("");

  const pager = $("#history-pager");
  pager.hidden = false;
  const start = state.offset + 1;
  const end = Math.min(state.offset + state.pageSize, state.total);
  $("#pager-info").textContent = `Showing ${start}–${end} of ${state.total}`;
  $("#prev-btn").disabled = state.offset === 0;
  $("#next-btn").disabled = end >= state.total;
}

function renderError(container, message) {
  const el = typeof container === "string" ? $(container) : container;
  el.hidden = false;
  el.className = "msg bad";
  el.textContent = message;
}

async function loadStats() {
  try {
    const { body } = await api("/api/v1/decisions/stats");
    renderStats(body);
  } catch (err) {
    renderError("#history-error", "Could not load overview: " + err.message);
  }
}

async function loadHistory() {
  const ul = $("#history-list");
  ul.innerHTML = '<li class="sk"></li><li class="sk"></li><li class="sk"></li>';
  $("#history-error").hidden = true;
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      limit: String(state.pageSize),
      offset: String(state.offset),
    });
    if (state.status) params.set("status", state.status);
    const { body, headers } = await api("/api/v1/decisions?" + params.toString());
    state.decisions = body;
    state.total = parseInt(headers.get("X-Total-Count") || "0", 10);
    renderHistory();
  } catch (err) {
    ul.innerHTML = "";
    renderError("#history-error", "Could not load history: " + err.message);
  }
}

/* ---- Inspector ---- */
async function loadDetail(id) {
  const panel = $("#inspector-panel");
  panel.hidden = false;
  $("#inspector-content").innerHTML = '<div class="sk" style="height:160px"></div>';

  const [detailR, engR] = await Promise.allSettled([
    api("/api/v1/decisions/" + encodeURIComponent(id)),
    api("/api/v1/decisions/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "/engineering"),
  ]);

  if (detailR.status === "rejected") {
    $("#inspector-content").innerHTML = '<p class="msg bad">' + esc(detailR.reason.message) + '</p>';
    return;
  }

  state.detail = detailR.value.body;
  state.engineering = engR.status === "fulfilled" ? engR.value.body : null;
  state.engineeringError = engR.status === "rejected" ? engR.reason.message : null;
  state.verification = null;

  renderInspector();
}

function selectDecision(id) {
  state.selectedId = id;
  renderHistory();
  loadDetail(id);
  $("#inspector-panel").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
}
window.selectDecision = selectDecision;

function renderInspector() {
  const d = state.detail;
  if (!d) return;

  const req = d.request || {};
  const result = d.result || {};
  const smDecision = result.state_machine_decision || {};
  const evidence = result.evidence || {};
  const calcIn = evidence.calculation_inputs || {};
  const uncertainty = result.uncertainty || {};
  const explanation = result.explanation || {};
  const sensitivity = result.sensitivity || [];
  const fingerprint = result.fingerprint || {};
  const constraints = smDecision.evaluated_constraints || [];
  const { current: curC, predicted: predC } = splitConstraints(constraints);

  const html = [
    renderIdentity(d),
    renderSummary(explanation, d),
    renderEngineering(state.engineering, state.engineeringError),
    renderProposedChange(req, calcIn),
    renderInputs(req, uncertainty),
    renderConstraints(curC, predC),
    renderEvidence(evidence, fingerprint, d),
    renderUncertainty(uncertainty, req),
    renderSensitivity(sensitivity),
    renderWhy(explanation, smDecision, result, d),
  ].join("");

  $("#inspector-content").innerHTML = html;

  const btn = $("#verify-btn");
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener("click", runVerify);
}

function renderIdentity(d) {
  const req = d.request || {};
  return `
    <header class="inspector-head" data-section="identity">
      <div>
        <h2>Decision <code>${esc(String(d.id).slice(0, 16))}…</code></h2>
        <div class="inspector-meta">
          ${statusPill(d.status)}
          <span>Precedence: <code>${esc(d.precedence)}</code></span>
          <span>Created ${esc(timeAgo(d.created_at))}</span>
          <span>Decision timestamp: <code>${esc(d.decision_timestamp)}</code></span>
          <span>Engine <code>${esc(d.engine_version)}</code></span>
          <span>Config <code>${esc(d.config_version)}</code></span>
          ${req.mode ? `<span>Mode: <code>${esc(req.mode)}</code></span>` : ""}
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>`;
}

function renderSummary(explanation, d) {
  if (!explanation.summary && !explanation.limiting_constraint) {
    return `<div class="inspector-summary">
      <strong>No summary available.</strong>
      <p class="muted">This record has no explanation bundle recorded.</p>
    </div>`;
  }
  return `
    <div class="inspector-summary" data-section="summary">
      <strong>${esc(explanation.summary || "—")}</strong>
      <dl class="kv" style="margin-top:.5rem">
        <dt>Status</dt><dd>${esc(d.status)}</dd>
        <dt>Limiting constraint</dt><dd>${esc(explanation.limiting_constraint || "—")}</dd>
        <dt>Headroom</dt><dd>${esc(explanation.headroom_summary || "—")}</dd>
      </dl>
    </div>`;
}

function engCard(label, value, unit) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || (typeof value === "number" && Number.isNaN(value))) {
    return `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">${esc(label)}</div><div class="v unavail">Unavailable</div></div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">${esc(label)}</div><div class="v">${nf2.format(value)}<span class="unit">${esc(unit)}</span></div></div>`;
}

function headroomCard(label, h) {
  if (!h || h.permitted_kw === null || h.permitted_kw === undefined) {
    return `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">${esc(label)}</div><div class="v unavail">Unavailable</div></div>`;
  }
  const pct = h.permitted_kw > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (Math.max(0, h.headroom_to_permitted_kw) / h.permitted_kw) * 100)) : 0;
  const cls = h.headroom_to_permitted_kw < 0 ? "alert" : pct < 20 ? "warn" : "";
  return `
    <div class="eng-card">
      <div class="k">${esc(label)}</div>
      <div class="v">${nf1.format(h.headroom_to_permitted_kw)}<span class="unit">kW</span></div>
      <div class="muted" style="font-size:.78rem;margin-top:.25rem">
        permitted ${nf1.format(h.permitted_kw)} kW · physical ${nf1.format(h.physical_capacity_kw)} kW
      </div>
      <div class="bar ${cls}" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
    </div>`;
}

function renderEngineering(e, err) {
  if (!e) {
    return `
      <details class="inspector-section" open data-section="engineering">
        <summary>Engineering snapshot</summary>
        <div class="body">
          <div class="msg bad">
            <strong>Engineering evidence unavailable.</strong><br>
            ${esc(err || "The stored decision does not contain the required engineering fields.")}
          </div>
          <p class="muted" style="font-size:.85rem">
            This typically means the record predates the PUE integration. The rest of
            the inspector still reflects exactly what is stored.
          </p>
        </div>
      </details>`;
  }
  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" open data-section="engineering">
      <summary>Engineering snapshot</summary>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="eng-grid">
          ${engCard("PUE", e.pue, "×")}
          <div class="eng-card">
            <div class="k">PUE provenance</div>
            <div class="v" style="font-size:1rem;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600">${esc(e.pue_provenance)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="split">
          <div class="col">
            <h4>Current state</h4>
            <div class="row"><span>IT load</span><span class="val">${fnum(e.current_it_load_kw, "kW")}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span>Facility power</span><span class="val">${fnum(e.current_facility_power_kw, "kW")}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span>Cooling load</span><span class="val">${fnum(e.current_cooling_load_kw, "kW")}</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="col">
            <h4>Predicted state</h4>
            <div class="row"><span>IT load</span><span class="val">${fnum(e.predicted_it_load_kw, "kW")}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span>Facility power</span><span class="val">${fnum(e.predicted_facility_power_kw, "kW")}</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span>Cooling load</span><span class="val">${fnum(e.predicted_cooling_load_kw, "kW")}</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="eng-grid">
          ${headroomCard("Electrical headroom (current)", e.current_electrical)}
          ${headroomCard("Electrical headroom (predicted)", e.predicted_electrical)}
          ${headroomCard("Cooling headroom (current)", e.current_cooling)}
          ${headroomCard("Cooling headroom (predicted)", e.predicted_cooling)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function renderProposedChange(req, calcIn) {
  const rawIt = req.proposed_it_delta;
  const rawCool = req.proposed_cooling_delta;
  const effIt = calcIn.proposed_it_delta_kw;
  const effCool = calcIn.proposed_cooling_delta_kw;
  const invalid = calcIn.invalid_proposal_reasons || [];

  const deltaRow = (label, raw, eff) => {
    if (raw === undefined) return "";
    const differs = (eff !== undefined) && (Number(raw) !== Number(eff));
    return `<div class="row">
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>
      <span class="val">${fnum(raw, "kW")}${differs ? ` <span class="muted">(effective ${nf2.format(eff)} kW)</span>` : ""}</span>
    </div>`;
  };

  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="proposed-change">
      <summary>Proposed change <span class="summary-tag">${invalid.length ? `${invalid.length} invalid reason(s)` : "valid"}</span></summary>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="split">
          <div class="col">
            <h4>Submitted deltas</h4>
            ${deltaRow("IT load delta", rawIt, effIt)}
            ${deltaRow("Cooling load delta", rawCool, effCool)}
            ${(rawIt === undefined && rawCool === undefined) ? '<p class="muted">No change deltas recorded.</p>' : ""}
          </div>
          <div class="col">
            <h4>Measurement availability at request</h4>
            <dl class="kv">
              <dt>IT load present</dt><dd>${req.it_load && req.it_load.value !== null ? "yes" : "no"}</dd>
              <dt>Cooling present</dt><dd>${req.cooling_load && req.cooling_load.value !== null ? "yes" : "no"}</dd>
            </dl>
          </div>
        </div>
        ${invalid.length ? `
          <h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Invalid reasons</h4>
          <ul class="reason-list fail">${invalid.map((r) => `<li>${esc(r)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>
        ` : ""}
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function renderInputs(req, uncertainty) {
  const measurements = [
    ["it_load", "IT load"],
    ["cooling_load", "Cooling load"],
    ["pue", "PUE"],
  ];
  const cards = measurements.map(([key, label]) => {
    const m = req[key];
    if (!m) {
      return `<div class="input-card">
        <div class="input-name">${esc(key)}</div>
        <p class="msg empty">Not recorded in this request.</p>
      </div>`;
    }
    const sourceCls = String(m.source || "").toLowerCase();
    const uncertaintyInfo = m.uncertainty
      ? `
        <dt>Absolute tolerance</dt><dd>${fnum(m.uncertainty.absolute_tolerance, "kW")}</dd>
        <dt>Relative tolerance</dt><dd>${m.uncertainty.relative_tolerance !== null && m.uncertainty.relative_tolerance !== undefined ? `${(m.uncertainty.relative_tolerance * 100).toFixed(2)}%` : '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>'}</dd>
        ${m.uncertainty.notes ? `<dt>Notes</dt><dd>${esc(m.uncertainty.notes)}</dd>` : ""}
      `
      : `<dt>Tolerance</dt><dd class="muted">Not supplied</dd>`;
    return `
      <div class="input-card">
        <div class="input-name">${esc(key)} — ${esc(label)}
          <span class="source-tag ${sourceCls}">${esc(m.source || "UNKNOWN")}</span>
        </div>
        <dl class="kv">
          <dt>Value</dt><dd>${fnum(m.value, m.unit || "")}</dd>
          <dt>Unit</dt><dd>${esc(m.unit || "—")}</dd>
          <dt>Reference ID</dt><dd>${m.reference_id ? `<code>${esc(m.reference_id)}</code>` : '<span class="muted">Not recorded</span>'}</dd>
          <dt>Meter ID</dt><dd>${m.meter_id ? `<code>${esc(m.meter_id)}</code>` : '<span class="muted">Not recorded</span>'}</dd>
          <dt>Timestamp</dt><dd>${m.measurement_timestamp ? `<code>${esc(m.measurement_timestamp)}</code>` : '<span class="muted">Not recorded</span>'}</dd>
          ${uncertaintyInfo}
        </dl>
      </div>`;
  }).join("");

  const missing = uncertainty.missing_measurements || [];
  const stale = uncertainty.stale_measurements || [];
  const qflags = req.quality_flags || uncertainty.quality_flags || [];

  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="inputs">
      <summary>Input measurements <span class="summary-tag">${missing.length || stale.length ? `${missing.length + stale.length} issue(s)` : "clean"}</span></summary>
      <div class="body">
        ${cards}
        <h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Quality eligibility</h4>
        <dl class="kv">
          <dt>Eligible for analysis</dt><dd>${req.quality_eligible === true ? "yes" : req.quality_eligible === false ? "no" : '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>'}</dd>
          <dt>Marked stale</dt><dd>${req.quality_stale === true ? "yes" : "no"}</dd>
          <dt>Max measurement age</dt><dd>${req.max_measurement_age_seconds !== null && req.max_measurement_age_seconds !== undefined ? `${nf.format(req.max_measurement_age_seconds)} s` : '<span class="muted">No limit enforced</span>'}</dd>
        </dl>
        <div class="tags">
          ${missing.map((m) => `<span class="tag alert">missing: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
          ${stale.map((m) => `<span class="tag warn">stale: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
          ${qflags.map((f) => `<span class="tag warn">flag: ${esc(f)}</span>`).join("")}
          ${(!missing.length && !stale.length && !qflags.length) ? '<span class="tag">no issues</span>' : ""}
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function constraintBlock(label, list) {
  if (!list || !list.length) {
    return `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">${esc(label)}</h4><p class="msg empty">No ${esc(label.toLowerCase())} recorded.</p>`;
  }
  const cards = list.map((ev) => `
    <div class="constraint-card">
      <div class="head">
        <span class="name">${esc(ev.name)}${ev.is_limiting ? '<span class="is-limiting">limiting</span>' : ""}</span>
        ${severityPill(ev.severity)}
      </div>
      <dl class="kv">
        <dt>Observed</dt><dd>${fnum(ev.observed, "kW")}</dd>
        <dt>Permitted limit</dt><dd>${fnum(ev.permitted, "kW")}</dd>
        <dt>Physical capacity</dt><dd>${fnum(ev.physical_capacity, "kW")}</dd>
        <dt>Headroom to permitted</dt><dd>${fnum(ev.headroom_to_permitted, "kW")}</dd>
        <dt>Headroom to physical</dt><dd>${fnum(ev.headroom_to_physical, "kW")}</dd>
        <dt>Used</dt><dd>${ev.margin_used_pct !== null && ev.margin_used_pct !== undefined ? nf2.format(ev.margin_used_pct) + "%" : '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>'}</dd>
      </dl>
      <p class="reason">${esc(ev.reason || "")}</p>
    </div>`).join("");
  return `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">${esc(label)}</h4>${cards}`;
}

function renderConstraints(cur, pred) {
  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="constraints">
      <summary>Constraint inspection <span class="summary-tag">${cur.length + pred.length} evaluation(s)</span></summary>
      <div class="body">
        ${constraintBlock("Current state", cur)}
        ${constraintBlock("Predicted state", pred)}
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function renderEvidence(evidence, fingerprint, d) {
  const formulas = evidence.formulas || {};
  const assumptions = evidence.assumptions || [];
  const snapshot = evidence.constraints_snapshot || {};
  const refs = evidence.input_references || [];

  const fingerprintBlock = `
    <h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.5rem 0 .35rem">Fingerprints</h4>
    <div class="fp-line"><span>Input fingerprint</span>${fp(d.input_fingerprint || fingerprint.input_fingerprint)}</div>
    <div class="fp-line"><span>Config fingerprint</span>${fp(d.config_fingerprint || fingerprint.config_fingerprint)}</div>
    <div class="fp-line"><span>Engine version</span><code>${esc(d.engine_version)}</code></div>
    <div class="fp-line"><span>Config version</span><code>${esc(d.config_version)}</code></div>`;

  const refsBlock = refs.length
    ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Input references</h4>
       <ul class="reason-list">${refs.map((r) => `
         <li>
           <strong>${esc(r.name)}</strong> · ${fnum(r.value, r.unit)}
           ${r.reference_id ? ` · <code>${esc(r.reference_id)}</code>` : ""}
           ${r.timestamp ? ` · <span class="muted">${esc(r.timestamp)}</span>` : ""}
           <br><span class="muted" style="font-size:.8rem">source: ${esc(r.source)}</span>
         </li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : '<p class="msg empty">No input references recorded.</p>';

  const formulasBlock = Object.keys(formulas).length
    ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Formulas used</h4>
       <dl class="kv">${Object.entries(formulas).map(([k, v]) => `<dt>${esc(k)}</dt><dd><code>${esc(v)}</code></dd>`).join("")}</dl>`
    : "";

  const assumptionsBlock = assumptions.length
    ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Assumptions</h4>
       <ul class="reason-list">${assumptions.map((a) => `<li>${esc(a)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : "";

  const snapshotBlock = Object.keys(snapshot).length
    ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Constraints snapshot</h4>
       <pre style="background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 8%, transparent);padding:.75rem;border-radius:8px;overflow-x:auto;font-size:.8rem"><code>${esc(JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2))}</code></pre>`
    : "";

  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="evidence">
      <summary>Evidence & reproducibility</summary>
      <div class="body">
        ${fingerprintBlock}
        ${refsBlock}
        ${formulasBlock}
        ${assumptionsBlock}
        ${snapshotBlock}
        <h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Verification</h4>
        <p class="muted" style="font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:.5rem">
          Verification recomputes the input and configuration fingerprints and re-runs the engine
          to confirm the top-level status matches. The full evidence bundle is not reproduced;
          <code>full_bundle_reproduced</code> is always <code>false</code>.
        </p>
        <button class="btn ghost" id="verify-btn" type="button">Verify integrity</button>
        <div id="verify-result" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function renderUncertainty(u, req) {
  const estimated = u.estimated_parameters || [];
  const tolerances = u.tolerance_used || [];
  const rationale = u.rationale || [];
  const limitations = u.model_limitations || [];
  const assumptions = u.assumptions || [];
  const conflicts = req.conflicting_inputs || [];
  const uncertaintyFlags = req.uncertainty_flags || [];

  const levels = `
    <dl class="kv">
      <dt>Data quality level</dt><dd>${u.data_quality_level ? `<span class="pill ${u.data_quality_level === "OK" ? "ok" : u.data_quality_level === "DEGRADED" ? "warn" : "alert"}">${esc(u.data_quality_level)}</span>` : '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>'}</dd>
      <dt>Model uncertainty</dt><dd>${u.model_uncertainty_level ? `<span class="pill ${u.model_uncertainty_level === "LOW" ? "ok" : u.model_uncertainty_level === "MODERATE" ? "warn" : u.model_uncertainty_level === "HIGH" ? "alert" : "neutral"}">${esc(u.model_uncertainty_level)}</span>` : '<span class="muted">Unavailable</span>'}</dd>
    </dl>`;

  const tagsBlock = `
    <div class="tags">
      ${(u.missing_measurements || []).map((m) => `<span class="tag alert">missing: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${(u.stale_measurements || []).map((m) => `<span class="tag warn">stale: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${(u.low_quality_measurements || []).map((m) => `<span class="tag warn">low-quality: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${estimated.map((m) => `<span class="tag warn">estimated: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${tolerances.map((m) => `<span class="tag">tolerance: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${conflicts.map((c) => `<span class="tag alert">conflict: ${esc(c)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${uncertaintyFlags.map((f) => `<span class="tag warn">flag: ${esc(f)}</span>`).join("")}
    </div>`;

  const listBlock = (title, items, cls) => items.length
    ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">${esc(title)}</h4>
       <ul class="reason-list ${cls || ""}">${items.map((x) => `<li>${esc(x)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : "";

  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="uncertainty">
      <summary>Uncertainty</summary>
      <div class="body">
        ${levels}
        ${tagsBlock}
        ${listBlock("Rationale", rationale)}
        ${listBlock("Assumptions in force", assumptions)}
        ${listBlock("Model limitations", limitations)}
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function renderSensitivity(sensitivity) {
  const items = sensitivity || [];
  const html = items.length
    ? `<ul class="reason-list ${items.some((s) => s.could_change_verdict) ? "warn-list" : "pass"}">${items.map((s) => `
        <li>
          <strong>${esc(s.measurement_name)}</strong> · could flip: <em>${s.could_change_verdict ? "yes" : "no"}</em>
          ${s.lower_bound !== null && s.lower_bound !== undefined ? ` · band [${nf2.format(s.lower_bound)}, ${nf2.format(s.upper_bound)}]` : ""}
          <br><span class="muted" style="font-size:.85rem">${esc(s.reason)}</span>
        </li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : '<p class="msg empty">No tolerance metadata was supplied for this decision, so sensitivity analysis was not performed.</p>';

  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="sensitivity">
      <summary>Sensitivity analysis <span class="summary-tag">${items.length} measurement(s)</span></summary>
      <div class="body">${html}</div>
    </details>`;
}

const PRECEDENCE_REASON = {
  "clean": "APPROVE: All constraints passed with no unresolved issues.",
  "hard_limit_violation": "REJECT: A projected value exceeded its physical capacity.",
  "reserve_violation": "REJECT: A projected value exceeded the permitted limit after reserve.",
  "invalid_proposal": "REJECT: The proposed change was physically invalid.",
  "data_quality_ineligible": "REVIEW: Data quality is ineligible for automatic approval.",
  "near_threshold": "REVIEW: A constraint is within its warning margin.",
  "uncertainty": "REVIEW: Uncertainty flags were present.",
  "conflicting_inputs": "REVIEW: Conflicting inputs were present.",
};

function renderWhy(explanation, smDecision, result, d) {
  const passed = (result.evidence && result.evidence.passed_constraints) || [];
  const warnings = (result.evidence && result.evidence.warning_constraints) || [];
  const failed = (result.evidence && result.evidence.failed_constraints) || [];
  const whatWould = explanation.what_would_change_decision || [];
  const rawReasons = smDecision.reasons || [];
  const unresolved = smDecision.unresolved_conditions || [];
  const precedence = d.precedence;
  const whyText = PRECEDENCE_REASON[precedence] || `Decision status: ${d.status} (precedence ${precedence}).`;

  const reasonsList = (title, items, cls) => items.length
    ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">${esc(title)}</h4>
       <ul class="reason-list ${cls}">${items.map((r) => `<li>${esc(r.reason)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : "";

  const pueProv = (result.evidence && result.evidence.calculation_inputs && result.evidence.calculation_inputs.pue_provenance) || "UNKNOWN";

  return `
    <details class="inspector-section" data-section="why-decision">
      <summary>Why this decision?</summary>
      <div class="body">
        <p style="padding:.75rem 1rem;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 6%, transparent);border-radius:8px;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:.5rem">
          ${esc(whyText)}
        </p>
        ${rawReasons.length ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Recorded reasons</h4>
          <ul class="reason-list">${rawReasons.map((r) => `<li>${esc(r)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>` : ""}
        ${unresolved.length ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Unresolved conditions</h4>
          <ul class="reason-list warn-list">${unresolved.map((r) => `<li>${esc(r)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>` : ""}
        ${reasonsList("Passed constraints", passed, "pass")}
        ${reasonsList("Warning constraints", warnings, "warn-list")}
        ${reasonsList("Failed constraints", failed, "fail")}
        ${whatWould.length ? `<h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">What would change the outcome</h4>
          <ul class="reason-list warn-list">${whatWould.map((r) => `<li>${esc(r)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>` : ""}
        <h4 class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:.75rem 0 .35rem">Inputs influencing the outcome</h4>
        <p style="font-size:.9rem">
          PUE provenance: <code>${esc(pueProv)}</code>.
          ${pueProv !== "MEASURED" ? `<br><span class="muted">PUE was not measured; facility power (IT load × PUE) was therefore computed from a ${esc(pueProv.toLowerCase())} value.</span>` : ""}
          ${(result.uncertainty && result.uncertainty.estimated_parameters || []).length ? `<br><span class="muted">Estimated parameters: ${esc((result.uncertainty.estimated_parameters || []).join(", "))}.</span>` : ""}
        </p>
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

async function runVerify() {
  if (!state.selectedId) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById("verify-btn");
  const out = document.getElementById("verify-result");
  if (!btn || !out) return;
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  out.className = "";
  out.textContent = "";
  try {
    const { body } = await api("/api/v1/decisions/" + encodeURIComponent(state.selectedId) + "/verify");
    state.verification = body;
    renderVerification(body);
  } catch (err) {
    out.className = "msg bad";
    out.textContent = "Verification failed: " + err.message;
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
}

function renderVerification(v) {
  const out = document.getElementById("verify-result");
  if (!out) return;
  const cls = v.verified ? "verify-result ok" : "verify-result bad";
  const label = v.verified ? "Verified" : "Verification failed";
  const detail = [
    `input ${v.computed_input_fingerprint === v.stored_input_fingerprint ? "match" : "MISMATCH"}`,
    `config ${v.computed_config_fingerprint === v.stored_config_fingerprint ? "match" : "MISMATCH"}`,
    `status ${v.recomputed_status === v.stored_status ? "match" : "MISMATCH"}`,
    `engine_version_match ${v.engine_version_match ? "yes" : "NO"}`,
    `scope ${v.verification_scope}`,
    `full_bundle_reproduced ${v.full_bundle_reproduced ? "yes" : "no"}`,
  ];
  out.className = cls;
  out.innerHTML = `<strong>${esc(label)}</strong><br><span style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem">${esc(detail.join(" · "))}</span>`;
}

/* ---- wiring ---- */
$("#filter-status").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
  state.status = e.target.value;
  state.offset = 0;
  loadHistory();
});
$("#prev-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  state.offset = Math.max(0, state.offset - state.pageSize);
  loadHistory();
});
$("#next-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  state.offset += state.pageSize;
  loadHistory();
});
$("#refresh-btn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  await Promise.all([loadStats(), loadHistory()]);
  if (state.selectedId) await loadDetail(state.selectedId);
});

(async function init() {
  await Promise.all([loadStats(), loadHistory()]);
})();

setInterval(() => {
  if (document.hidden) return;
  loadStats().catch(() => {});
  loadHistory().catch(() => {});
}, 30000);
</script>

<script>
const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat();
const kwh = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(undefined, { numeric: "auto" });
const esc = (v) => String(v ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
async function api(url, opts) {
  let res;
  try { res = await fetch(url, opts); }
  catch (err) { throw new Error("Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again."); }
  const text = await res.text();
  let body;
  try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch (err) { body = { detail: text || res.statusText }; }
  if (!res.ok) {
    let d = body && body.detail;
    if (d && typeof d === "object" && !Array.isArray(d) && d.message) {
      d = d.code ? `${d.message} [${d.code}]` : d.message;   // structured API error
    } else if (d && typeof d !== "string") d = JSON.stringify(d);
    throw new Error(`Server error ${res.status}: ${d || "request failed"}`);
  }
  return body;
}

function toast(message, kind) {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "toast" + (kind === "bad" ? " bad" : "");
  el.textContent = message;
  $("#toasts").appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), kind === "bad" ? 7000 : 4000);
}

function setLive(ok) {
  $("#live").dataset.state = ok ? "ok" : "bad";
  $("#live-text").textContent = ok ? "Live" : "Offline, retrying";
}

function timeAgo(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d)) return "";
  const s = Math.round((Date.now() - d) / 1000);
  for (const [unit, sec] of [["day", 86400], ["hour", 3600], ["minute", 60]]) {
    if (Math.abs(s) >= sec) return rtf.format(-Math.round(s / sec), unit);
  }
  return "just now";
}

/* ---------- stats ---------- */
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
function countTo(el, to) {
  const from = el._v ?? 0; el._v = to;
  cancelAnimationFrame(el._raf);
  if (reduceMotion || from === to) { el.textContent = nf.format(to); return; }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const step = (t) => {
    const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 900);
    el.textContent = nf.format(Math.round(from + (to - from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4))));
    if (p < 1) el._raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  el._raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
async function loadStats() {
  const d = await api("/api/v1/dashboard/stats");
  const open = d.open_incidents ?? 0;
  countTo($("#stat-buildings"), d.buildings ?? 0);
  countTo($("#stat-meters"), d.meters ?? 0);
  countTo($("#stat-open"), open);
  $("#stat-open").classList.toggle("hot", open > 0);
  countTo($("#stat-total"), d.total_incidents ?? 0);
}

/* ---------- chart ---------- */
let chart = null, fullData = null, lastKey = "", cType = "line", cRange = "all";
const cssVar = (n) => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
const rgba = (hex, a) => { const h = hex.replace("#", ""); const n = parseInt(h.length === 3 ? h.replace(/./g, "$&$&") : h, 16); return `rgba(${(n >> 16) & 255},${(n >> 8) & 255},${n & 255},${a})`; };
const avgOf = (v) => v.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / v.length;
const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

function view() {
  const N = fullData.data.length;
  const n = cRange === "half" ? Math.ceil(N / 2) : cRange === "quarter" ? Math.ceil(N / 4) : N;
  return { labels: fullData.labels.slice(N - n), values: fullData.data.slice(N - n) };
}

const chartPlugins = [
  { id: "reveal",
    beforeDatasetsDraw(c) { const p = c._p ?? 1; if (p < 1) { const a = c.chartArea, g = c.ctx; g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.rect(0, 0, a.left + (a.right - a.left) * p + 8, c.height); g.clip(); c._clip = true; } },
    afterDatasetsDraw(c) { if (c._clip) { c.ctx.restore(); c._clip = false; } } },
  { id: "marks",
    afterDatasetsDraw(c) {
      if ((c._p ?? 1) < 1) return;
      const g = c.ctx, a = c.chartArea, vals = c.data.datasets[0].data, pts = c.getDatasetMeta(0).data;
      if (!vals.length || !pts.length) return;
      const avg = avgOf(vals), ay = c.scales.y.getPixelForValue(avg), accent = cssVar("--accent"), muted = cssVar("--muted");
      g.save();
      g.setLineDash([4, 5]); g.strokeStyle = muted; g.globalAlpha = 0.55; g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(a.left, ay); g.lineTo(a.right, ay); g.stroke();
      g.setLineDash([]); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.fillStyle = muted; g.font = '500 11px "DM Sans", sans-serif'; g.textAlign = "right"; g.textBaseline = "bottom";
      g.fillText("avg " + kwh.format(avg), a.right, ay - 4);
      const mi = vals.indexOf(Math.max(...vals)), pk = pts[mi];
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(pk.x, pk.y, 5, 0, 6.2832); g.fillStyle = cssVar("--paper"); g.fill(); g.lineWidth = 2; g.strokeStyle = accent; g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle = cssVar("--ink"); g.font = '600 11px "DM Sans", sans-serif'; g.textAlign = "center";
      g.fillText(kwh.format(vals[mi]), Math.min(Math.max(pk.x, a.left + 22), a.right - 22), pk.y - 10);
      if (c.config.type === "line") {
        const l = pts[pts.length - 1];
        g.fillStyle = rgba(accent, 0.22); g.beginPath(); g.arc(l.x, l.y, 9, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
        g.fillStyle = accent; g.beginPath(); g.arc(l.x, l.y, 4, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
      }
      g.restore();
    } },
  { id: "crosshair",
    afterDatasetsDraw(c) {
      const act = c.tooltip && c.tooltip.getActiveElements ? c.tooltip.getActiveElements() : [];
      if (!act.length || c.config.type !== "line") return;
      const g = c.ctx, a = c.chartArea;
      g.save(); g.setLineDash([3, 4]); g.strokeStyle = cssVar("--muted"); g.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(act[0].element.x, a.top); g.lineTo(act[0].element.x, a.bottom); g.stroke(); g.restore();
    } }
];

function buildChart() {
  if (chart) { chart.destroy(); chart = null; }
  if (typeof Chart === "undefined" || !fullData) return;
  Chart.defaults.font.family = '"DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
  const { labels, values } = view(), accent = cssVar("--accent"), muted = cssVar("--muted"), line = cssVar("--line"), bar = cType === "bar";
  chart = new Chart($("#chart").getContext("2d"), {
    type: cType,
    plugins: chartPlugins,
    data: { labels, datasets: [{
      label: "Consumption (kWh)", data: values, borderColor: accent, borderWidth: bar ? 0 : 2.5, tension: 0.38, fill: true,
      pointRadius: 0, pointHoverRadius: 6, pointHoverBackgroundColor: cssVar("--paper"), pointHoverBorderColor: accent, pointHoverBorderWidth: 2,
      borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false, hoverBackgroundColor: accent,
      backgroundColor: (ctx) => {
        const a = ctx.chart.chartArea;
        if (bar || !a) return rgba(accent, bar ? 0.72 : 0.2);
        const g = ctx.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0, a.top, 0, a.bottom);
        g.addColorStop(0, rgba(accent, 0.38)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(accent, 0));
        return g;
      }
    }] },
    options: {
      responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, layout: { padding: { top: 20, right: 6 } },
      animation: {
        duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 1300, easing: "easeOutQuart",
        onProgress(c) { if (!c.chart._done) c.chart._p = c.currentStep / c.numSteps; },
        onComplete(c) { c.chart._done = true; c.chart._p = 1; }
      },
      interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: cssVar("--ink"), titleColor: cssVar("--paper"), bodyColor: cssVar("--paper"), footerColor: cssVar("--paper"),
          displayColors: false, padding: 12, cornerRadius: 8, caretSize: 0,
          callbacks: {
            label: (c) => kwh.format(c.parsed.y) + " kWh",
            afterLabel: (c) => { const avg = avgOf(c.dataset.data), d = ((c.parsed.y - avg) / avg) * 100; return (d >= 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(d) + "% vs average"; }
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: muted, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: true, maxTicksLimit: 6 }, border: { color: line } },
        y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: line }, ticks: { color: muted, maxTicksLimit: 5, callback: (v) => compact.format(v) }, border: { display: false } }
      }
    }
  });
  chart._p = reduceMotion ? 1 : 0;
}

function renderSeg(el, items, active) {
  el.style.setProperty("--n", items.length);
  el.style.setProperty("--i", Math.max(0, items.findIndex(([v]) => v === active)));
  el.innerHTML = items.map(([v, l]) => `<button type="button" data-v="${v}" aria-pressed="${v === active}">${l}</button>`).join("");
}
function renderTools() {
  const ranges = [["all", "All"]];
  if (fullData.data.length >= 8) ranges.push(["half", "Last half"], ["quarter", "Last quarter"]);
  if (!ranges.some(([v]) => v === cRange)) cRange = "all";
  renderSeg($("#seg-range"), ranges, cRange);
  $("#seg-range").hidden = ranges.length < 2;
  renderSeg($("#seg-type"), [["line", "Line"], ["bar", "Bars"]], cType);
}
function updateFacts() {
  const v = view().values;
  $("#f-peak").textContent = kwh.format(Math.max(...v)) + " kWh";
  $("#f-avg").textContent = kwh.format(avgOf(v)) + " kWh";
  $("#f-last").textContent = kwh.format(v[v.length - 1]) + " kWh";
}

async function loadChart() {
  const d = await api("/api/v1/dashboard/chart-data");
  const has = Array.isArray(d.data) && d.data.length > 0;
  $("#chart-empty").hidden = has; $("#facts").hidden = !has; $("#tools").hidden = !has;
  $("#chart").style.visibility = has ? "visible" : "hidden";
  if (!has) { fullData = null; lastKey = ""; if (chart) { chart.destroy(); chart = null; } return; }
  const key = JSON.stringify([d.labels, d.data]);
  if (key === lastKey && chart) return;
  lastKey = key;
  const first = !chart;
  fullData = { labels: d.data.map((_, i) => (d.labels || [])[i] ?? String(i + 1)), data: d.data.map(Number) };
  renderTools(); updateFacts();
  if (first) buildChart();
  else { const v = view(); chart.data.labels = v.labels; chart.data.datasets[0].data = v.values; chart.update("none"); }
}

$("#tools").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const b = e.target.closest("button[data-v]");
  if (!b || !fullData) return;
  if (b.parentElement.id === "seg-type") cType = b.dataset.v; else cRange = b.dataset.v;
  renderTools(); updateFacts(); buildChart();
});
window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", () => { if (fullData) buildChart(); });
window.addEventListener("load", () => { if (fullData && !chart) buildChart(); });

/* ---------- incidents ---------- */
const PILL = { DETECTED: "alert", UNDER_REVIEW: "warn" };
const NEXT = { DETECTED: { path: "review", label: "Start review", done: "Review started" }, UNDER_REVIEW: { path: "acknowledge", label: "Acknowledge", done: "Incident acknowledged" } };
const nice = (s) => { const t = String(s || "").toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, " "); return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1); };

let incKey = "";
function renderMix(list) {
  const c = {};
  list.forEach((i) => { c[i.status] = (c[i.status] || 0) + 1; });
  const parts = Object.entries(c);
  $("#mixwrap").hidden = parts.length === 0;
  $("#mix").innerHTML = parts.map(([st, n]) => `<i class="${PILL[st] || "ok"}" style="flex:${n}" title="${esc(nice(st))}: ${n}"></i>`).join("");
  $("#mixlegend").textContent = parts.map(([st, n]) => `${n} ${nice(st).toLowerCase()}`).join(", ");
}

async function loadIncidents() {
  const list = await api("/api/v1/incidents?limit=10");
  const ul = $("#incidents");
  const key = JSON.stringify(list);
  if (key === incKey) {
    ul.querySelectorAll("time[datetime]").forEach((t) => { t.textContent = timeAgo(t.getAttribute("datetime")); });
    return;
  }
  incKey = key;
  if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) {
    renderMix([]);
    ul.innerHTML = '<li class="empty">No incidents yet. Generate demo data or add a CSV to see them here.</li>';
    return;
  }
  renderMix(list);
  ul.innerHTML = list.map((inc, i) => {
    const next = NEXT[inc.status];
    const when = new Date(inc.created_at);
    return `<li class="inc" style="--i:${i}">
      <span class="pill ${PILL[inc.status] || "ok"}">${esc(nice(inc.status))}</span>
      <span class="inc-id" title="${esc(inc.id)}">${esc(String(inc.id).slice(0, 8))}</span>
      <time class="inc-time" datetime="${esc(inc.created_at)}" title="${isNaN(when) ? "" : esc(when.toLocaleString())}">${esc(timeAgo(inc.created_at))}</time>
      <span class="inc-act">${next ? `<button class="btn small" type="button" data-id="${esc(inc.id)}" data-path="${next.path}" data-done="${esc(next.done)}">${next.label}</button>` : ""}</span>
    </li>`;
  }).join("");
}

$("#incidents").addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-path]");
  if (!btn) return;
  btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  try {
    await api(`/api/v1/incidents/${encodeURIComponent(btn.dataset.id)}/${btn.dataset.path}`, {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ reason: "Actioned via dashboard" })
    });
    toast(btn.dataset.done);
    await Promise.allSettled([loadIncidents(), loadStats()]);
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.message, "bad");
    btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
});

/* ---------- refresh ---------- */
async function refreshAll() {
  const results = await Promise.allSettled([loadStats(), loadChart(), loadIncidents()]);
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === "rejected");
  setLive(failed.length === 0);
  if (failed.length === results.length) {
    const ul = $("#incidents");
    if (ul.querySelector(".sk")) ul.innerHTML = '<li class="empty">Couldn\'t load incidents. Retrying shortly.</li>';
  }
  return failed;
}

/* ---------- demo data ---------- */
$("#demo").addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
  const btn = e.currentTarget;
  btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  try {
    const d = await api("/api/v1/dashboard/generate-demo", { method: "POST" });
    toast(d.message || "Demo data generated");
    await refreshAll();
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.message, "bad");
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
});

/* ---------- CSV upload ---------- */
const drop = $("#drop"), fileInput = $("#file"), msg = $("#upload-msg");
function say(text, kind) { msg.textContent = text; msg.className = "msg " + (kind || ""); }

async function upload(file) {
  if (!file) return;
  if (!/\.csv$/i.test(file.name)) { say("That file isn't a .csv. Choose a CSV file.", "bad"); return; }
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("file", file);
  fd.append("source_id", "dashboard-upload");
  fd.append("batch_id", "batch-" + Date.now());
  say(`Uploading ${file.name}…`, "busy");
  try {
    const d = await api("/api/v1/imports", { method: "POST", body: fd });
    say(`Imported ${nf.format(d.accepted_rows ?? 0)} rows. ${nf.format(d.rejected_rows ?? 0)} rejected.`, "good");
    toast("CSV imported");
    await refreshAll();
  } catch (err) {
    say(err.message, "bad");
  } finally {
    fileInput.value = "";
  }
}

fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => upload(fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]));
["dragenter", "dragover"].forEach((t) => drop.addEventListener(t, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); drop.classList.add("over"); }));
["dragleave", "drop"].forEach((t) => drop.addEventListener(t, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); drop.classList.remove("over"); }));
drop.addEventListener("drop", (e) => upload(e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]));

/* ---------- start ---------- */
refreshAll();
setInterval(() => { if (!document.hidden) refreshAll(); }, 10000);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { if (!document.hidden) refreshAll(); });
</script>
</body>
</html>

            </div>

              <div class="field-head"><label for="in-token">X-EcoFac-Token</label></div>

                     style="width:100%;padding:.35rem .5rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;min-height:36px;background:var(--surface)">

<script>
"use strict";
const $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s, r) => Array.from((r || document).querySelectorAll(s));
const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat();
const nf1 = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
const nf2 = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(undefined, { numeric: "auto" });
const esc = (v) => String(v ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));

const state = {
  current: null,
  savedIds: [],
  history: [],
  historyTotal: 0,
  historyOffset: 0,
  historyLimit: 10,
};

function api(url, opts = {}) {
  const token = ($("#in-token") || {}).value;
  if (token) {
    opts.headers = Object.assign({}, opts.headers, { "X-EcoFac-Token": token });
  }
  return fetch(url, opts).then(async (res) => {
    const text = await res.text();
    let body;
    try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = { detail: text || res.statusText }; }
    if (!res.ok) {
      let d = body && body.detail;
      if (d && typeof d !== "string") d = JSON.stringify(d);
      throw new Error(`Server ${res.status}: ${d || "request failed"}`);
    }
    return { body, headers: res.headers };
  });
}

function timeAgo(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d)) return "-";
  const s = Math.round((Date.now() - d) / 1000);
  for (const [u, sec] of [["day", 86400], ["hour", 3600], ["minute", 60]]) {
    if (Math.abs(s) >= sec) return rtf.format(-Math.round(s / sec), u);
  }
  return "just now";
}

function statusPill(status) {
  const cls = status === "APPROVE" ? "ok" : status === "REJECT" ? "alert" : status === "REVIEW" ? "warn" : "neutral";
  return `<span class="pill ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
}

function readForm() {
  const num = (id) => Number($("#" + id).value);
  return {
    name: $("#in-name").value || "Untitled scenario",
    config: {
      electrical: {
        capacity: num("in-elec-cap"),
        reserve_pct: num("in-elec-res") / 100,
        warning_threshold_pct: num("in-warn") / 100,
      },
      cooling: {
        capacity: num("in-cool-cap"),
        reserve_pct: num("in-cool-res") / 100,
        warning_threshold_pct: num("in-warn") / 100,
      },
    },
    config_version: $("#in-cv").value || "",
    it_load_kw: num("in-it"),
    cooling_load_kw: num("in-cool"),
    pue: num("in-pue"),
    proposed_it_delta_kw: num("in-it-delta"),
    proposed_cooling_delta_kw: num("in-cool-delta"),
    it_source: "ASSUMED",
    cooling_source: "ASSUMED",
    pue_source: "ASSUMED",
    persist_as_decision: false,
  };
}

function validateForm() {
  let ok = true;
  $$(".field").forEach((f) => f.classList.remove("invalid"));
  const check = (id, valid) => {
    const el = $("#" + id);
    if (!el) return;
    const field = el.closest(".field");
    if (!field) return;
    if (!valid) { field.classList.add("invalid"); ok = false; }
  };
  const n = (id) => Number($("#" + id).value);
  check("in-it", n("in-it") >= 0);
  check("in-pue", n("in-pue") > 0);
  check("in-cool", n("in-cool") >= 0);
  check("in-elec-cap", n("in-elec-cap") > 0);
  check("in-cool-cap", n("in-cool-cap") > 0);
  check("in-elec-res", n("in-elec-res") >= 0 && n("in-elec-res") < 100);
  check("in-cool-res", n("in-cool-res") >= 0 && n("in-cool-res") < 100);
  check("in-warn", n("in-warn") >= 0 && n("in-warn") < 100);
  return ok;
}

function updatePreview() {
  try { $("#payload-preview").textContent = JSON.stringify(readForm(), null, 2); }
  catch { /* ignore */ }
}

function wireSliders() {
  $$('input[type="range"][data-target]').forEach((slider) => {
    const target = document.getElementById(slider.dataset.target);
    if (!target) return;
    slider.addEventListener("input", () => { target.value = slider.value; updatePreview(); });
    target.addEventListener("input", () => { slider.value = target.value; updatePreview(); });
  });
  $$("#scenario-form input, #scenario-form select").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("input", updatePreview);
    el.addEventListener("change", updatePreview);
  });
}

function engCard(label, value, unit, prov) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">${esc(label)}</div><div class="v unavail">Unavailable</div></div>`;
  }
  const provHtml = prov ? `<div class="prov">${esc(prov)}</div>` : "";
  return `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">${esc(label)}</div><div class="v">${nf1.format(value)}<span class="unit">${esc(unit)}</span></div>${provHtml}</div>`;
}

function constraintRow(ev) {
  const sev = ev.severity || "";
  const barCls = sev === "OK" ? "ok" : sev === "WARNING" ? "warn" : "alert";
  const used = ev.permitted && ev.permitted > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (ev.observed / ev.permitted) * 100)) : 0;
  const permMarker = ev.physical_capacity && ev.physical_capacity > 0 ? Math.min(100, (ev.permitted / ev.physical_capacity) * 100) : 0;
  return `
    <div class="constraint-row">
      <div class="cr-head">
        <span class="cr-name">${esc(ev.name)}${ev.is_limiting ? " (limiting)" : ""}</span>
        <span class="cr-nums">observed ${nf1.format(ev.observed)} / permitted ${nf1.format(ev.permitted)} / physical ${nf1.format(ev.physical_capacity)} kW</span>
      </div>
      <div class="bar ${barCls}" aria-hidden="true">
        <i style="width:${used}%"></i>
        <b style="left:${permMarker}%"></b>
      </div>
      <div class="cr-nums">headroom ${nf1.format(ev.headroom_to_permitted)} kW to permitted - ${nf1.format(ev.headroom_to_physical)} kW to physical</div>
      <div class="cr-nums" style="color:var(--muted)">${esc(ev.reason || "")}</div>
    </div>`;
}

function renderResult(payload) {
  const result = payload.result || {};
  const eng = result.evidence?.calculation_inputs || {};
  const expl = result.explanation || {};
  const uncertainty = result.uncertainty || {};
  const sm = result.state_machine_decision || {};
  const constraints = sm.evaluated_constraints || [];
  const elecs = constraints.filter((c) => c.name === "electrical");
  const cools = constraints.filter((c) => c.name === "cooling");

  const header = `
    <div class="decision-banner">
      <div>
        <div class="label">Decision</div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-top:.15rem">
          ${statusPill(result.status)}
          <code>${esc(result.precedence || "")}</code>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1">
        <div class="label">Reason</div>
        <div class="reason">${esc(expl.summary || sm.reasons?.[0] || "")}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const engBlock = `
    <div class="eng-grid">
      ${engCard("PUE", eng.pue, "x", eng.pue_provenance)}
      ${engCard("Current IT load", eng.current_it_load_kw, "kW")}
      ${engCard("Current facility power", eng.current_facility_power_kw, "kW")}
      ${engCard("Current cooling", eng.current_cooling_load_kw, "kW")}
      ${engCard("Predicted IT load", eng.predicted_it_load_kw, "kW")}
      ${engCard("Predicted facility power", eng.predicted_facility_power_kw, "kW")}
      ${engCard("Predicted cooling", eng.predicted_cooling_load_kw, "kW")}
      ${engCard("Proposed IT change", eng.proposed_it_delta_kw, "kW")}
    </div>`;

  const constraintBlock = `
    <div>
      ${elecs.map(constraintRow).join("")}
      ${cools.map(constraintRow).join("")}
    </div>`;

  const limited = expl.limiting_constraint
    ? `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">Limiting constraint</div><div class="v" style="font-size:1rem;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600">${esc(expl.limiting_constraint)}</div></div>`
    : "";

  const uncertaintyBlock = `
    <div class="eng-grid" style="margin-top:.5rem">
      ${uncertainty.data_quality_level ? `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">Data quality</div><div class="v" style="font-size:1rem;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600">${esc(uncertainty.data_quality_level)}</div></div>` : ""}
      ${uncertainty.model_uncertainty_level ? `<div class="eng-card"><div class="k">Model uncertainty</div><div class="v" style="font-size:1rem;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600">${esc(uncertainty.model_uncertainty_level)}</div></div>` : ""}
    </div>
    <div>
      ${(uncertainty.missing_measurements || []).map((m) => `<span class="tag alert">missing: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${(uncertainty.stale_measurements || []).map((m) => `<span class="tag warn">stale: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
      ${(uncertainty.quality_flags || []).map((m) => `<span class="tag warn">flag: ${esc(m)}</span>`).join("")}
    </div>`;

  const hints = (expl.what_would_change_decision || []).length
    ? `<ul class="reason-list warn-list">${expl.what_would_change_decision.map((h) => `<li>${esc(h)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : "";

  const saveBlock = `
    <div style="display:flex;gap:.5rem;margin-top:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
      <button class="btn ghost small" type="button" id="btn-save-compare">Save for comparison</button>
      <span id="save-msg" style="font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);align-self:center"></span>
    </div>`;

  $("#result-content").innerHTML = `
    ${header}
    ${engBlock}
    ${saveBlock}
    <details class="inspector-section" open>
      <summary>Constraints</summary>
      <div class="body">
        ${limited ? `<div class="eng-grid" style="margin-bottom:.5rem">${limited}</div>` : ""}
        ${constraintBlock}
      </div>
    </details>
    <details class="inspector-section">
      <summary>Uncertainty &amp; warnings</summary>
      <div class="body">${uncertaintyBlock}${hints}</div>
    </details>
    <details class="inspector-section">
      <summary>Technical details</summary>
      <div class="body">
        <dl class="kv">
          <dt>Scenario id</dt><dd><code>${esc(payload.scenario_id || "")}</code></dd>
          <dt>Decision id</dt><dd>${payload.decision_id ? `<code>${esc(payload.decision_id)}</code>` : '<span style="color:var(--muted)">not persisted</span>'}</dd>
          <dt>Engine version</dt><dd><code>${esc(result.engine_version || "")}</code></dd>
          <dt>Config version</dt><dd><code>${esc(result.config_version || "")}</code></dd>
          <dt>Timestamp</dt><dd><code>${esc(result.decision_timestamp || "")}</code></dd>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </details>
  `;

  $("#btn-save-compare").addEventListener("click", () => saveForComparison(payload.scenario_id));
  state.current = payload;
}

async function loadBottlenecksAndSensitivity(scenarioId) {
  try {
    const [b, s] = await Promise.all([
      api("/api/v1/scenarios/" + encodeURIComponent(scenarioId) + "/bottlenecks"),
      api("/api/v1/scenarios/" + encodeURIComponent(scenarioId) + "/sensitivity"),
    ]);
    appendAnalysis(b.body, s.body);
  } catch (err) {
    appendAnalysisError(err.message);
  }
}

function appendAnalysis(b, s) {
  const findings = (b.findings || []).map((f) => `
    <li>
      <strong>${esc(f.category)}</strong> (${esc(f.severity)})
      <br><span style="color:var(--muted)">${esc(f.reason)}</span>
    </li>`).join("");

  const findingsBlock = b.has_enough_information
    ? `<ul class="reason-list ${b.findings.some((f) => f.severity === "CRITICAL") ? "fail" : b.findings.some((f) => f.severity === "WARNING") ? "warn-list" : "pass"}">${findings}</ul>`
    : `<p class="msg empty">${esc(b.reason_if_insufficient || "No bottleneck analysis available.")}</p>`;

  const sensBlocks = (s.parameters || []).map((p) => `
    <div style="margin:.6rem 0">
      <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600">${esc(p.parameter)} <span style="color:var(--muted);font-weight:400">baseline ${nf2.format(p.baseline_value)}${p.units ? " " + esc(p.units) : ""}</span></div>
      <table class="sens-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Value</th><th>Status</th><th>Precedence</th><th>Flipped</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${p.steps.map((st) => `
            <tr class="${st.changed_from_baseline ? "changed" : ""}">
              <td>${nf2.format(st.value)}</td>
              <td>${statusPill(st.status)}</td>
              <td><code>${esc(st.precedence)}</code></td>
              <td>${st.changed_from_baseline ? "yes" : "-"}</td>
            </tr>`).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`).join("");

  $("#result-content").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `
    <details class="inspector-section">
      <summary>Bottleneck analysis</summary>
      <div class="body">
        <div style="margin-bottom:.5rem">
          <strong>Most restrictive:</strong> ${esc(b.most_restrictive_constraint || "not determined")}
        </div>
        ${findingsBlock}
      </div>
    </details>
    <details class="inspector-section">
      <summary>Sensitivity analysis</summary>
      <div class="body">
        ${sensBlocks || '<p class="msg empty">No sensitivity parameters available.</p>'}
      </div>
    </details>
  `);
}

function appendAnalysisError(msg) {
  $("#result-content").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `
    <details class="inspector-section">
      <summary>Additional analysis</summary>
      <div class="body"><p class="msg bad">Analysis unavailable: ${esc(msg)}</p></div>
    </details>
  `);
}

function saveForComparison(scenarioId) {
  if (!scenarioId) return;
  if (!state.savedIds.includes(scenarioId)) state.savedIds.push(scenarioId);
  $("#save-msg").textContent = `Saved ${state.savedIds.length} for comparison.`;
  renderComparison();
}

async function renderComparison() {
  if (state.savedIds.length < 2) {
    $("#comparison-content").innerHTML = `<p class="msg empty">Save at least 2 scenarios to compare (${state.savedIds.length} saved).</p>`;
    return;
  }
  $("#comparison-content").innerHTML = `<button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-run-compare">Compare ${state.savedIds.length} scenarios</button>`;
  $("#btn-run-compare").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const btn = $("#btn-run-compare");
    btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
    try {
      const { body } = await api("/api/v1/scenarios/compare", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ scenario_ids: state.savedIds }),
      });
      renderComparisonResult(body);
    } catch (err) {
      $("#comparison-content").innerHTML = `<p class="msg bad">${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
    } finally {
      btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
    }
  });
}

function renderComparisonResult(comp) {
  const cols = ["", "Status", "PUE", "Facility power (current -> predicted)", "Cooling (current -> predicted)", "Electrical headroom", "Cooling headroom", "Most restrictive"];
  const rows = comp.scenarios.map((s) => [
    esc(s.name),
    statusPill(s.status),
    s.pue !== null ? nf2.format(s.pue) : "-",
    (s.current_facility_power_kw !== null && s.predicted_facility_power_kw !== null)
      ? `${nf1.format(s.current_facility_power_kw)} -> ${nf1.format(s.predicted_facility_power_kw)} kW`
      : "-",
    (s.current_cooling_load_kw !== null && s.predicted_cooling_load_kw !== null)
      ? `${nf1.format(s.current_cooling_load_kw)} -> ${nf1.format(s.predicted_cooling_load_kw)} kW`
      : "-",
    s.predicted_electrical_headroom_kw !== null ? nf1.format(s.predicted_electrical_headroom_kw) + " kW" : "-",
    s.predicted_cooling_headroom_kw !== null ? nf1.format(s.predicted_cooling_headroom_kw) + " kW" : "-",
    esc(s.most_restrictive_constraint || "-"),
  ]);

  const diffTable = `
    <table class="comp-table">
      <thead><tr>${cols.map((c) => `<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows.map((r) => `<tr>${r.map((c) => `<td>${c}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`;

  const diffFields = (comp.input_differences || []).filter((d) => d.differs);
  const diffBlock = diffFields.length
    ? `<table class="comp-table">
         <thead><tr><th>Input field</th><th>Units</th><th>Values</th></tr></thead>
         <tbody>
           ${diffFields.map((d) => `<tr class="diff"><td>${esc(d.field_name)}</td><td>${esc(d.units || "")}</td><td>${d.values.map((v) => esc(String(v))).join(" / ")}</td></tr>`).join("")}
         </tbody>
       </table>`
    : `<p class="msg empty">No input differences.</p>`;

  const mixed = comp.mixed_config_versions
    ? `<p class="msg bad">Mixed config versions across scenarios (${esc(comp.config_versions.join(", "))}).</p>`
    : "";

  $("#comparison-content").innerHTML = `
    ${mixed}
    ${diffTable}
    <h3 style="font-size:.9rem;margin-top:1rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600">Input differences</h3>
    ${diffBlock}
    <h3 style="font-size:.9rem;margin-top:1rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600">Explanation</h3>
    <p style="font-size:.9rem">${esc(comp.outcome_explanation || "")}</p>
    <div style="margin-top:.75rem">
      <button class="btn ghost small" type="button" id="btn-clear-compare">Clear saved scenarios</button>
    </div>
  `;
  $("#btn-clear-compare").addEventListener("click", () => { state.savedIds = []; renderComparison(); });
}

async function loadHistory() {
  const ul = $("#history-list");
  ul.innerHTML = '<li class="sk"></li><li class="sk"></li><li class="sk"></li>';
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(state.historyLimit), offset: String(state.historyOffset) });
    const { body, headers } = await api("/api/v1/scenarios?" + params.toString());
    state.history = body;
    state.historyTotal = parseInt(headers.get("X-Total-Count") || "0", 10);
    renderHistory();
  } catch (err) {
    ul.innerHTML = `<li><p class="msg bad">${esc(err.message)}</p></li>`;
  }
}

function renderHistory() {
  const ul = $("#history-list");
  if (!state.history.length) {
    ul.innerHTML = `<li><p class="msg empty">No scenarios yet.</p></li>`;
    $("#history-pager").hidden = true;
    return;
  }
  ul.innerHTML = state.history.map((h) => `
    <li tabindex="0" role="button" data-id="${esc(h.id)}" class="${state.current && state.current.scenario_id === h.id ? "selected" : ""}">
      <div class="h-name">${esc(h.name)}</div>
      <div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;font-family:var(--mono)">${esc((h.id || "").slice(0, 8))}...</div>
      <div class="h-when">${esc(timeAgo(h.created_at))} ${statusPill(h.status)}</div>
    </li>`).join("");

  $$("#history-list li[data-id]").forEach((li) => {
    const reopen = () => openHistoryRecord(li.dataset.id);
    li.addEventListener("click", reopen);
    li.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); reopen(); } });
  });

  const pager = $("#history-pager");
  pager.hidden = false;
  const start = state.historyOffset + 1;
  const end = Math.min(state.historyOffset + state.historyLimit, state.historyTotal);
  $("#pager-info").textContent = `${start}-${end} of ${state.historyTotal}`;
  $("#prev-btn").disabled = state.historyOffset === 0;
  $("#next-btn").disabled = end >= state.historyTotal;
}

async function openHistoryRecord(id) {
  try {
    const { body: record } = await api("/api/v1/scenarios/" + encodeURIComponent(id));
    // Populate form from stored inputs + config
    const inputs = record.inputs || {};
    const config = record.config || {};
    const setVal = (elId, value) => { const el = $("#" + elId); if (el && value !== undefined && value !== null) el.value = value; };
    $("#in-name").value = record.name || "Untitled scenario";
    $("#in-it").value = inputs.it_load?.value ?? 400;
    $("#in-pue").value = inputs.pue?.value ?? 1.0;
    $("#in-cool").value = inputs.cooling_load?.value ?? 300;
    $("#in-it-delta").value = inputs.proposed_it_delta ?? 0;
    $("#in-cool-delta").value = inputs.proposed_cooling_delta ?? 0;
    setVal("in-elec-cap", config.electrical?.capacity);
    setVal("in-cool-cap", config.cooling?.capacity);
    setVal("in-elec-res", (config.electrical?.reserve_pct ?? 0.1) * 100);
    setVal("in-cool-res", (config.cooling?.reserve_pct ?? 0.1) * 100);
    setVal("in-warn", (config.electrical?.warning_threshold_pct ?? 0.1) * 100);
    $("#in-cv").value = record.config_version || "";

    // Synthesise a result payload compatible with renderResult
    const fakePayload = {
      scenario_id: record.id,
      decision_id: record.decision_id,
      result: record.result,
    };
    renderResult(fakePayload);
    await loadBottlenecksAndSensitivity(record.id);
    renderHistory();
    document.getElementById("result-panel").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  } catch (err) {
    $("#result-content").innerHTML = `<p class="msg bad">Failed to open scenario: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  }
}

async function submitEvaluation(ev) {
  if (ev) ev.preventDefault();
  if (!validateForm()) return;
  const btn = $("#btn-evaluate");
  btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  $("#result-content").innerHTML = '<div class="sk" style="height:120px"></div>';
  try {
    const payload = readForm();
    const { body } = await api("/api/v1/scenarios/evaluate", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    renderResult(body);
    await loadBottlenecksAndSensitivity(body.scenario_id);
    loadHistory();
  } catch (err) {
    $("#result-content").innerHTML = `<p class="msg bad">Evaluation failed: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
}

function resetForm() {
  $("#scenario-form").reset();
  $$('input[type="range"][data-target]').forEach((slider) => {
    const target = document.getElementById(slider.dataset.target);
    if (target) target.value = slider.value;
  });
  updatePreview();
}

// ---- wiring ----
$("#scenario-form").addEventListener("submit", submitEvaluation);
$("#btn-reset").addEventListener("click", resetForm);
$("#prev-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  state.historyOffset = Math.max(0, state.historyOffset - state.historyLimit);
  loadHistory();
});
$("#next-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  state.historyOffset += state.historyLimit;
  loadHistory();
});

(function init() {
  wireSliders();
  updatePreview();
  loadHistory();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

          <li class="sk"></li><li class="sk"></li><li class="sk"></li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section class="panel" aria-labelledby="testdrive-heading">
        <h2 id="testdrive-heading">Test drive</h2>
        <p class="sub">Calibrated hypothetical presets, evaluated through the canonical decision engine. Not derived from current meter readings.</p>
        <div class="testdrive">
          <button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="btn-eval-plus10">Test drive: +10% baseline</button>
          <button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="btn-eval-plus40">Test drive: +40% baseline</button>
          <button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="btn-verify-latest">Verify latest decision</button>
          <button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="btn-inspect-incident">Inspect latest incident</button>
        </div>
        <div id="action-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="panel" aria-labelledby="legend-heading">
        <h2 id="legend-heading">Legend</h2>
        <div class="legend">
          <div><span class="sw" style="background:var(--ok)"></span>No open incidents</div>
          <div><span class="sw" style="background:var(--warn)"></span>Has open incidents (low/medium)</div>
          <div><span class="sw" style="background:var(--alert)"></span>Has severe incident (high)</div>
          <div><span class="sw" style="background:var(--stale)"></span>No valid reading</div>

  <button class="close" id="drawer-close" aria-label="Close details">&times;</button>
  <div id="drawer-content"></div>
