<script>
"use strict";

const $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s, r) => Array.from((r || document).querySelectorAll(s));
const nf1 = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(undefined, { numeric: "auto" });
const esc = (v) => String(v ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));

const state = {
  world: null,
  prevMeterState: {},
  view: "datacenter",
  selectedMeter: null,
  polling: true,
};

function timeAgo(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d)) return "—";
  const s = Math.round((Date.now() - d) / 1000);
  for (const [u, sec] of [["day", 86400], ["hour", 3600], ["minute", 60]]) {
    if (Math.abs(s) >= sec) return rtf.format(-Math.round(s / sec), u);
  }
  return "just now";
}

function statusPill(status) {
  const cls = status === "APPROVE" || status === "RESOLVED" || status === "DISMISSED" ? "ok"
    : status === "REJECT" || status === "UNRESOLVED" ? "alert"
    : status === "REVIEW" || status === "UNDER_REVIEW" || status === "ACKNOWLEDGED" ? "warn"
    : "neutral";
  return `<span class="pill ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
}

function meterStatus(meter) {
  if (!meter.latest_reading || !meter.latest_reading.is_valid) return "stale";
  if (meter.open_incidents >= 3) return "alert";
  if (meter.open_incidents >= 1) return "warn";
  return "ok";
}

function zoneStatus(meters) {
  if (!meters.length) return "stale";
  const statuses = meters.map(meterStatus);
  if (statuses.includes("alert")) return "alert";
  if (statuses.includes("warn")) return "warn";
  if (statuses.every((s) => s === "stale")) return "stale";
  return "ok";
}

function rackHTML(meter) {
  const st = meterStatus(meter);
  const val = meter.latest_reading ? nf1.format(meter.latest_reading.value) : "—";
  const badge = meter.open_incidents > 0 ? `${meter.open_incidents} open` : "healthy";
  return `
    <div class="rack" data-status="${st}" data-meter-id="${esc(meter.id)}"
         tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Meter ${esc(meter.id)} — ${st}">
      <span class="led" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div class="meter-id">${esc(meter.id)}</div>
      <div class="meter-val">${val}<span class="meter-unit">${esc(meter.unit)}</span></div>
      <div class="meter-badge">${esc(badge)}</div>
    </div>`;
}

function renderDataCenter(world) {
  const stage = $("#viz-stage");
  if (!world.buildings.length) {
    stage.innerHTML = '<p class="msg empty">No buildings or meters in the demo facility.</p>';
    return;
  }
  stage.innerHTML = `
    <div class="dc-floor">
      ${world.buildings.map((b) => `
        <div class="dc-zone" data-status="${zoneStatus(b.meters)}">
          <div class="dc-zone-name"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-datacenter"/></svg><span>${esc(b.name)}</span> <span style="opacity:.6">(${esc(b.id)})</span></div>
          <div class="dc-racks">${b.meters.map(rackHTML).join("")}</div>
        </div>`).join("")}
    </div>`;
  attachRackHandlers();
}

function renderBuilding(world) {
  const stage = $("#viz-stage");
  if (!world.buildings.length) {
    stage.innerHTML = '<p class="msg empty">No buildings to display.</p>';
    return;
  }
  stage.innerHTML = `
    <div class="bld-skyline">
      ${world.buildings.map((b) => `
        <div class="bld-tower">
          <div class="bld-floors">
            ${b.meters.map((m) => `
              <div class="bld-floor" data-status="${meterStatus(m)}" data-meter-id="${esc(m.id)}"
                   tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Meter ${esc(m.id)}">
                <span>${esc(m.id)}</span>
                <span class="win" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              </div>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <div class="bld-name"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-building"/></svg><span>${esc(b.name)}</span></div>
        </div>`).join("")}
    </div>`;
  attachRackHandlers();
}

function attachRackHandlers() {
  $$("#viz-stage [data-meter-id]").forEach((el) => {
    const open = () => openMeterDrawer(el.dataset.meterId);
    el.addEventListener("click", open);
    el.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); open(); }
    });
  });
}

function renderEvents(world) {
  const ul = $("#events-list");
  const events = world.recent_events || [];
  if (!events.length) {
    ul.innerHTML = '<li class="msg empty" style="display:block">No events yet.</li>';
    return;
  }
  ul.innerHTML = events.map((e) => {
    if (e.type === "incident") {
      return `<li>
        <span class="ev-type">INC</span>
        <span class="ev-main">${esc(e.meter_id)} ${statusPill(e.status)} <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem">${esc(e.detector_name || "")} ${esc(e.severity || "")}</span></span>
        <span class="ev-when">${esc(timeAgo(e.timestamp))}</span>
      </li>`;
    }
    return `<li>
      <span class="ev-type">DEC</span>
      <span class="ev-main">${statusPill(e.status)} <code style="font-size:.72rem">${esc(e.precedence)}</code></span>
      <span class="ev-when">${esc(timeAgo(e.timestamp))}</span>
    </li>`;
  }).join("");
}

function pulseChangedMeters(world) {
  const next = {};
  for (const b of world.buildings) {
    for (const m of b.meters) {
      next[m.id] = m.open_incidents;
    }
  }
  for (const [id, count] of Object.entries(next)) {
    if (state.prevMeterState[id] !== undefined && state.prevMeterState[id] !== count) {
      const el = document.querySelector(`[data-meter-id="${id}"]`);
      if (el) {
        el.classList.remove("pulse");
        void el.offsetWidth;
        el.classList.add("pulse");
        setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("pulse"), 1200);
      }
    }
  }
  state.prevMeterState = next;
}

async function fetchWorld() {
  const res = await fetch("/api/v1/world/state");
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`world state ${res.status}`);
  return await res.json();
}

async function refresh() {
  try {
    const world = await fetchWorld();
    state.world = world;
    if (state.view === "datacenter") renderDataCenter(world);
    else renderBuilding(world);
    renderEvents(world);
    pulseChangedMeters(world);
    if (state.selectedMeter) refreshDrawer();
  } catch (err) {
    $("#viz-stage").innerHTML = `<p class="msg bad">Failed to load facility state: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  }
}

function switchView(view) {
  state.view = view;
  $$(".tabs button").forEach((b) => {
    const on = b.dataset.view === view;
    b.classList.toggle("active", on);
    b.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
  });
  if (state.world) {
    if (view === "datacenter") renderDataCenter(state.world);
    else renderBuilding(state.world);
  }
}

function openMeterDrawer(meterId) {
  state.selectedMeter = meterId;
  $("#drawer").classList.add("open");
  refreshDrawer();
}

async function refreshDrawer() {
  const meterId = state.selectedMeter;
  if (!meterId) return;
  const drawer = $("#drawer-content");
  drawer.innerHTML = '<div class="sk" style="height:200px"></div>';
  try {
    const meter = await fetch(`/api/v1/meters/${encodeURIComponent(meterId)}`).then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`meter ${r.status}`);
      return r.json();
    });
    const world = state.world;
    let ourMeter = null;
    if (world) {
      for (const b of world.buildings) {
        const m = b.meters.find((x) => x.id === meterId);
        if (m) { ourMeter = { ...m, building: b }; break; }
      }
    }
    const recentForMeter = (world?.recent_events || []).filter((e) => e.meter_id === meterId).slice(0, 5);

    drawer.innerHTML = `
      <h3>${esc(meterId)}</h3>
      <div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem">${esc(ourMeter?.building?.name || meter.building_id)}</div>
      <dl class="kv">
        <dt>Fuel type</dt><dd>${esc(meter.fuel_type)}</dd>
        <dt>Unit</dt><dd>${esc(meter.unit)}</dd>
        <dt>Interval</dt><dd>${esc(meter.interval_minutes)} min</dd>
        <dt>Latest reading</dt><dd>${ourMeter?.latest_reading ? `${nf1.format(ourMeter.latest_reading.value)} ${esc(meter.unit)} <span style="color:var(--muted)">@ ${esc(ourMeter.latest_reading.timestamp_utc)}</span>` : 'No reading'}</dd>
        <dt>Open incidents</dt><dd>${esc(ourMeter?.open_incidents ?? 0)}</dd>
        <dt>Total incidents</dt><dd>${esc(ourMeter?.total_incidents ?? 0)}</dd>
      </dl>
      ${recentForMeter.length ? `
        <h3 style="margin-top:1rem;font-size:.95rem">Recent events</h3>
        <ul class="inc-list">
          ${recentForMeter.map((e) => `<li>${statusPill(e.status)} <code style="font-size:.72rem">${esc(e.type)}</code> <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem">${esc(timeAgo(e.timestamp))}</span></li>`).join("")}
        </ul>` : ''}
    `;
  } catch (err) {
    drawer.innerHTML = `<p class="msg bad">${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  }
}

function closeDrawer() {
  $("#drawer").classList.remove("open");
  state.selectedMeter = null;
}

function setActionMsg(text, kind) {
  const box = $("#action-msg");
  box.className = `msg ${kind || "empty"}`;
  box.innerHTML = text;
}

async function runTestDrive(presetId, buttonId) {
  // Canonical test-drive endpoint. It uses calibrated hypothetical inputs
  // (source=ASSUMED) and deliberately does NOT average meter readings:
  // meters report kWh per interval, not kW, and unrelated meters cannot be
  // summed into a facility total.
  const btn = $(`#${buttonId}`);
  btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  setActionMsg(`Running test drive "${presetId}"...`, "empty");
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/world/test-drive/${encodeURIComponent(presetId)}`);
    const body = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(body.detail?.message || `test drive ${res.status}`);
    }
    const result = body.result;
    const matchNote = body.matches_expected
      ? "(as expected)"
      : "<strong>unexpected!</strong>";
    setActionMsg(
      `Test drive ${esc(presetId)}: ${statusPill(result.status)} `
      + `<code style="font-size:.78rem">${esc(result.precedence)}</code> ${matchNote} `
      + "\u00b7 hypothetical; not persisted",
      result.status === "APPROVE" ? "ok" : result.status === "REVIEW" ? "warn" : "bad"
    );
  } catch (err) {
    setActionMsg(`Test drive failed: ${esc(err.message)}`, "bad");
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
}

async function verifyLatest() {
  const btn = $("#btn-verify-latest");
  btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  try {
    const latest = (state.world?.recent_events || []).find((e) => e.type === "decision");
    if (!latest) { setActionMsg("No decisions to verify yet.", "empty"); return; }
    const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/decisions/${encodeURIComponent(latest.id)}/verify`);
    const body = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.detail || `status ${res.status}`);
    const msg = `Verified=${body.verified} output=${body.output_verified} engine_match=${body.engine_version_match} scope=${esc(body.verification_scope)}`;
    setActionMsg(msg, body.verified ? "ok" : "warn");
  } catch (err) {
    setActionMsg(`Verify failed: ${esc(err.message)}`, "bad");
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
}

async function inspectLatestIncident() {
  const btn = $("#btn-inspect-incident");
  btn.disabled = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  try {
    const latest = (state.world?.recent_events || []).find((e) => e.type === "incident");
    if (!latest) { setActionMsg("No incidents yet. Generate demo data first.", "empty"); return; }
    const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/incidents/${encodeURIComponent(latest.id)}/evidence`);
    const body = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.detail || `status ${res.status}`);
    const count = Array.isArray(body) ? body.length : 0;
    setActionMsg(`Incident ${latest.id.slice(0, 8)}... has ${count} evidence record(s). Open it in <a href="/decisions">Decision Center</a>.`, "ok");
  } catch (err) {
    setActionMsg(`Inspect failed: ${esc(err.message)}`, "bad");
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
  }
}

// ---- wiring ----
$$(".tabs button").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => switchView(b.dataset.view)));
$("#drawer-close").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
$("#btn-eval-plus10").addEventListener("click", () => runTestDrive("plus_10pct", "btn-eval-plus10"));
$("#btn-eval-plus40").addEventListener("click", () => runTestDrive("plus_40pct", "btn-eval-plus40"));
$("#btn-verify-latest").addEventListener("click", verifyLatest);
$("#btn-inspect-incident").addEventListener("click", inspectLatestIncident);

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape") closeDrawer();
});

refresh();
setInterval(() => { if (!document.hidden) refresh(); }, 5000);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { if (!document.hidden) refresh(); });
</script>
</body>
</html>

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb

"""Time utility functions."""

import datetime as dt


def now_z() -> str:
    """Return the current UTC time as ISO 8601 (microseconds, 'Z' suffix).

    Microseconds are always present so that string ordering matches time ordering.
    """
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def parse_utc(ts: str) -> dt.datetime:
    """Parse an ISO 8601 timestamp into an aware UTC datetime.

    Naive timestamps are rejected instead of being guessed as local time.
    Python 3.11+ fromisoformat handles the 'Z' suffix natively.
    """
    parsed = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        msg = f"Naive timestamp not allowed: {ts}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return parsed.astimezone(dt.UTC)


def to_z(dt_obj: dt.datetime) -> str:
    """Convert an aware datetime to a canonical ISO 8601 UTC string with a 'Z' suffix."""
    if dt_obj.tzinfo is None:
        msg = "Naive datetime not allowed"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return dt_obj.astimezone(dt.UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _reset_rate_limiter_between_tests() -> Generator[None, None, None]:
    """Clear the rate-limiter buckets so tests do not bleed state.

    Rate limiting is on by default (DEF-20); without this reset the 600
    reads/min default would accumulate across the whole session.
    """
    reset_rate_limiter()
    yield
    reset_rate_limiter()

    # Seed base metadata
    now = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"

    conn.execute("INSERT INTO buildings (id, org_id, name, created_at) VALUES ('b1', 'o1', 'Bldg', ?)", (now,))

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb

"""Cross-endpoint smoke test — proves the full request chain still works."""

HEADER = "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n"


def _spike_csv() -> str:
    rows = [f"2026-01-01T{h:02d}:00:00Z,b1,m1,10.0,kWh\n" for h in range(24)]
    rows.append("2026-01-02T00:00:00Z,b1,m1,100.0,kWh\n")
    return HEADER + "".join(rows)


def test_api_smoke_sequence(client):
    """Exercise every user-facing endpoint in a realistic sequence."""
    # 1. Health
    assert client.get("/health").json() == {"status": "ok"}

    # 2. Empty dashboard (conftest seeds one building and one meter)
    stats = client.get("/api/v1/dashboard/stats").json()
    assert stats["buildings"] == 1
    assert stats["meters"] == 1
    assert stats["total_incidents"] == 0

    # 3. Entity endpoints
    buildings = client.get("/api/v1/buildings").json()
    assert len(buildings) == 1
    assert buildings[0]["id"] == "b1"
    meters = client.get("/api/v1/meters").json()
    assert len(meters) == 1
    assert meters[0]["id"] == "m1"

    # 4. Upload a CSV that produces an anomaly
    resp = client.post(
        "/api/v1/imports",
        files={"file": ("spike.csv", _spike_csv(), "text/csv")},
        data={"source_id": "s1", "batch_id": "ib-smoke"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["accepted_rows"] == 25
    assert body["rejected_rows"] == 0
    # Analysis runs automatically after import; both detectors fire
    assert body["anomalies_detected"] >= 1
    assert body["incidents_created"] >= 1

    # 5. Dashboard now shows activity
    stats2 = client.get("/api/v1/dashboard/stats").json()
    assert stats2["total_incidents"] >= 1
    assert stats2["open_incidents"] >= 1

    # 6. Chart endpoint returns valid readings
    chart = client.get("/api/v1/dashboard/chart-data").json()
    assert chart["meter_id"] == "m1"
    assert len(chart["data"]) > 0

    # 7. Incidents list includes the newly created incident
    incidents = client.get("/api/v1/incidents").json()
    assert len(incidents) >= 1
    incident_id = incidents[0]["id"]
    assert incidents[0]["status"] == "DETECTED"

    # 8. Evidence is retrievable
    evidence = client.get(f"/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/evidence").json()
    assert len(evidence) >= 1
    assert "computation_log" in evidence[0]

    # 9. Manual re-analysis on the same timestamp is idempotent
    reanalysis = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze/m1", params={"timestamp": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"}
    ).json()
    assert reanalysis["status"] == "anomalies_detected"
    assert all(f["already_recorded"] for f in reanalysis["findings"])

    # 10. Lifecycle transition works over HTTP
    resp = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/review",
        json={"reason": "Investigating via smoke test"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["status"] == "UNDER_REVIEW"

    # 11. Audit endpoint returns the transition
    audit = client.get("/api/v1/audit").json()
    assert any(
        a["entity_id"] == incident_id and "TRANSITION" in a["action"]
        for a in audit
    )

    # 12. Dashboard root HTML renders
    html = client.get("/").text
    assert "EcoFac" in html
    assert 'id="incidents"' in html

FILE: tests/api/test_audit_regressions.py

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb

"""HTTP-level regression tests for the audit fixes."""

HEADER = "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n"
FLAT = HEADER + "".join(f"2026-01-01T{h:02d}:00:00Z,b1,m1,10.0,kWh\n" for h in range(24))
SPIKE = HEADER + "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z,b1,m1,100.0,kWh\n"


def _post_csv(client, text, batch, source="s1", **params):
    return client.post(
        "/api/v1/imports",
        files={"file": ("data.csv", text, "text/csv")},
        data={"source_id": source, "batch_id": batch},
        params=params,
    )


def test_import_runs_analysis_and_opens_one_incident(client):
    assert _post_csv(client, FLAT, "ib-flat").json()["anomalies_detected"] == 0
    body = _post_csv(client, SPIKE, "ib-spike").json()
    assert body["anomalies_detected"] == 2
    assert body["incidents_created"] == 1
    assert len(client.get("/api/v1/incidents").json()) == 1


def test_import_analysis_can_be_disabled(client):
    _post_csv(client, FLAT, "ib-flat")
    body = _post_csv(client, SPIKE, "ib-spike", analyze="false").json()
    assert body["anomalies_detected"] == 0
    assert client.get("/api/v1/incidents").json() == []


def test_analyze_accepts_offset_timestamps_and_reports_recorded_findings(client):
    _post_csv(client, FLAT, "ib-flat")
    _post_csv(client, SPIKE, "ib-spike", analyze="false")
    resp = client.post("/api/v1/analyze/m1", params={"timestamp": "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00"})
    findings = resp.json()["findings"]
    assert len(findings) == 2
    assert len({f["incident_id"] for f in findings}) == 1
    again = client.post("/api/v1/analyze/m1", params={"timestamp": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"})
    assert all(f["already_recorded"] for f in again.json()["findings"])
    incident_id = findings[0]["incident_id"]
    assert len(client.get(f"/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/evidence").json()) == 2


def test_gated_anomaly_never_becomes_an_incident(client):
    # 23 readings (hour 23 missing) -> the quality window before the spike has a gap.
    gappy = HEADER + "".join(
        f"2026-01-01T{h:02d}:00:00Z,b1,m1,10.0,kWh\n" for h in range(23)
    ) + "2025-12-31T23:00:00Z,b1,m1,10.0,kWh\n"
    _post_csv(client, gappy, "ib-gappy")
    _post_csv(client, SPIKE, "ib-spike", analyze="false")
    body = client.post("/api/v1/analyze/m1", params={"timestamp": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"}).json()
    assert body["status"] == "anomalies_detected"
    assert all(f["gated_by_quality"] and f["incident_id"] is None for f in body["findings"])
    assert client.get("/api/v1/incidents").json() == []


def test_unknown_meter_and_bad_ranges_are_rejected(client):
    assert client.post("/api/v1/analyze/nope", params={"timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}).status_code == 404
    resp = client.get("/api/v1/quality/nope", params={"start": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "end": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"})
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    resp = client.get("/api/v1/quality/m1", params={"start": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z", "end": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"})
    assert resp.status_code == 400


def test_batch_reuse_and_bad_ids_are_rejected(client):
    assert _post_csv(client, FLAT, "ib-1").status_code == 200
    assert _post_csv(client, FLAT, "ib-1").status_code == 409
    assert _post_csv(client, FLAT, "ib-1", source="other").status_code == 409
    assert _post_csv(client, FLAT, "bad id!").status_code == 422

    resp = client.get("/decisions")

        html,
    )
    assert uuids == [], f"template hardcodes decision IDs: {uuids}"

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb
"""API tests for the decision engine endpoints."""

import json

BASE = "/api/v1/decisions"


def _req(
    *,
    it_value=400.0,
    cool_value=300.0,
    it_tol=None,
    quality=True,
    quality_stale=False,
    quality_flags=None,
    it_source="MEASURED",
    config_version="cfg-1",
    supersedes=None,
    supersession_reason=None,
    pue_value=None,
    pue_source="MEASURED",
    it_unit="kW",
    cool_unit="kW",
    it_meter_id=None,
    it_timestamp=None,
    mode="hypothetical",
    cap=1000.0,
):
    it_uncertainty = (
        {"absolute_tolerance": it_tol} if it_tol is not None else None
    )
    it_load: dict = {
        "name": "it_load",
        "value": it_value,
        "unit": it_unit,
        "source": it_source,
        "uncertainty": it_uncertainty,
        "reference_id": "reading-it-1",
    }
    if it_timestamp is not None:
        it_load["measurement_timestamp"] = it_timestamp
    if it_meter_id is not None:
        it_load["meter_id"] = it_meter_id
    payload_decision: dict = {
        "config": {
            "electrical": {"capacity": cap, "reserve_pct": 0.10},
            "cooling": {"capacity": 800.0, "reserve_pct": 0.10},
        },
        "config_version": config_version,
        "it_load": it_load,
        "cooling_load": {
            "name": "cooling_load",
            "value": cool_value,
            "unit": cool_unit,
            "source": "MEASURED",
        },
        "proposed_it_delta": 0.0,
        "proposed_cooling_delta": 0.0,
        "quality_eligible": quality,
        "quality_stale": quality_stale,
        "quality_flags": quality_flags or [],
        "uncertainty_flags": [],
        "conflicting_inputs": [],
        "mode": mode,
    }
    if pue_value is not None:
        payload_decision["pue"] = {
            "name": "pue",
            "value": pue_value,
            "unit": "dimensionless",
            "source": pue_source,
        }
    payload: dict = {"decision": payload_decision}
    if supersedes is not None:
        payload["supersedes"] = supersedes
    if supersession_reason is not None:
        payload["supersession_reason"] = supersession_reason
    return payload


def _evaluate(client, **kwargs):
    return client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=_req(**kwargs))

def test_trusted_mode_rejects_partial_trust(client, test_db):
    """A trusted IT reading must not be mixed with caller-supplied cooling.

    Regression: this request (IT referenced, cooling supplied by the caller)
    used to be accepted with HTTP 200.
    """
    test_db.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO import_batches "
        "(id, source_id, status, imported_at) "
        "VALUES ('ib1', 's1', 'started', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')"
    )
    test_db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO energy_readings "
        "(id, meter_id, timestamp_utc, value, unit, source_id, batch_id, "
        "is_valid, created_at) "
        "VALUES ('r1', 'm1', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 450.0, 'kWh', 's1', "
        "'ib1', 1, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')"
    )
    resp = _evaluate(
        client,
        mode="trusted",
        it_value=999.0,
        it_meter_id="m1",
        it_timestamp="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        cool_value=100.0,
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert "cooling_load" in resp.json()["detail"]


def test_trusted_mode_rejects_invalid_reading(client, test_db):
    test_db.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO import_batches "

        "VALUES ('r1', 'm1', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 450.0, 'kWh', 's1', "

    )
    resp = _evaluate(

# ---- Corrective action mode (DEF-19) ----
def test_corrective_action_mode_allows_repair(client):
    """Repairing an overload is accepted when corrective mode is on."""
    payload = _req(it_value=1100.0)  # current overload (> cap 1000)
    payload["decision"]["proposed_it_delta"] = -300.0  # predicted = 800
    payload["decision"]["corrective_action_mode"] = True
    resp = client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["result"]["status"] == "APPROVE"
    assert body["result"]["precedence"] == "clean"


def test_corrective_action_mode_default_is_conservative(client):
    """Without the flag, the current overload still blocks the repair."""
    payload = _req(it_value=1100.0)
    payload["decision"]["proposed_it_delta"] = -300.0
    resp = client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=payload)
    assert resp.json()["result"]["status"] == "REJECT"
    assert resp.json()["result"]["precedence"] == "hard_limit_violation"


def test_corrective_action_mode_still_rejects_predicted_violation(client):
    """Corrective mode does not excuse a still-overloaded prediction."""
    payload = _req(it_value=1100.0)
    payload["decision"]["proposed_it_delta"] = -50.0  # predicted 1050 > cap
    payload["decision"]["corrective_action_mode"] = True
    resp = client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=payload)
    assert resp.json()["result"]["status"] == "REJECT"


# ---- Evidence-bundle verification (DEF-21) ----
def test_verify_evidence_bundle_matches(client):
    """A fresh decision's evidence bundle must reproduce exactly."""
    did = _evaluate(client).json()["decision_id"]
    body = client.get(f"{BASE}/{did}/verify").json()
    assert body["evidence_bundle_verified"] is True
    assert body["evidence_bundle_diff"] is None


def test_verify_evidence_bundle_detects_tamper(client, test_db):
    """Tampering with stored evidence is detected even if fingerprints match."""
    did = _evaluate(client).json()["decision_id"]

    test_db.execute("DROP TRIGGER trg_decisions_no_update")
    row = test_db.execute(
        "SELECT result_json FROM decisions WHERE id = ?", (did,)
    ).fetchone()
    result = json.loads(row[0])
    result["evidence"]["final_status"] = "TAMPERED"
    test_db.execute(
        "UPDATE decisions SET result_json = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (json.dumps(result), did),
    )
    test_db.execute(
        "CREATE TRIGGER trg_decisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON decisions "
        "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'decisions is append-only'); END"
    )

    body = client.get(f"{BASE}/{did}/verify").json()
    assert body["evidence_bundle_verified"] is False
    assert body["evidence_bundle_diff"] is not None
    assert "final_status" in body["evidence_bundle_diff"]

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb

"""HTTP-level reliability tests for CSV imports: structured errors and all-or-nothing writes."""

import csv
import json
import sqlite3

import pytest

from ecofac.api.routes import imports as imports_route
from ecofac.constants import MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, MULTIPART_OVERHEAD_BYTES
from ecofac.ingestion import entities

HEADER = "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n"
TABLES = (
    "data_sources",
    "import_batches",
    "organizations",
    "buildings",
    "meters",
    "energy_readings",
    "data_quality_issues",
)


def _row(ts="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", building="b1", meter="m1", value="1.0", unit="kWh"):
    return f"{ts},{building},{meter},{value},{unit}\n"


def _post(client, content, batch="ib-x", source="src-x", **params):
    if isinstance(content, str):
        content = content.encode("utf-8")
    return client.post(
        "/api/v1/imports",
        files={"file": ("data.csv", content, "text/csv")},
        data={"source_id": source, "batch_id": batch},
        params=params,
    )


def _snapshot(db):
    return {
        table: db.execute(f"SELECT count(*) AS c FROM {table}").fetchone()["c"]
        for table in TABLES
    }


def _error(resp):
    detail = resp.json()["detail"]
    assert isinstance(detail, dict), detail
    assert {"code", "message"} <= set(detail)
    return detail


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- success path


def test_successful_import_is_recorded_atomically_and_reports_entities(client, test_db):
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row(building="b-new", meter="m-new"))
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert (body["accepted_rows"], body["buildings_created"], body["meters_created"]) == (1, 1, 1)

    batch = test_db.execute("SELECT * FROM import_batches WHERE id = 'ib-x'").fetchone()
    assert batch["status"] == "completed"
    assert json.loads(batch["summary_json"])["accepted_rows"] == 1
    assert client.get("/api/v1/imports/ib-x").json()["status"] == "completed"


def test_existing_supported_behaviour_is_unchanged(client):
    # Unknown source, existing building/meter, BOM, offsets: all still accepted.
    text = "\ufeff" + HEADER + _row(ts="2026-01-01T12:00:00+02:00")
    resp = _post(client, text, source="brand-new-source")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["accepted_rows"] == 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- failures leave no trace


def test_missing_columns_is_a_structured_400_and_leaves_no_trace(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    resp = _post(client, "timestamp,building_id\n2026-01-01T00:00:00Z,b-new\n")
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    detail = _error(resp)
    assert detail["code"] == "missing_columns"
    assert detail["rolled_back"] is True
    assert "meter_id" in detail["details"]["required"]
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before
    assert client.get("/api/v1/imports/ib-x").status_code == 404


def test_failed_batch_id_can_be_retried(client):
    assert _post(client, "bad,header\n1,2\n").status_code == 400
    assert _post(client, HEADER + _row()).status_code == 200


def test_invalid_utf8_is_a_structured_400_and_leaves_no_trace(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    resp = _post(client, b"\xff\xfe\x00bad")
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert _error(resp)["code"] == "invalid_encoding"
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


def test_malformed_csv_field_is_a_400_not_a_500(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    huge = "9" * (csv.field_size_limit() + 10)
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row() + _row(ts="2026-01-01T01:00:00Z", value=huge))
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    detail = _error(resp)
    assert detail["code"] == "malformed_csv"
    assert detail["rolled_back"] is True
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


def test_row_limit_is_a_structured_413_and_leaves_no_trace(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row() * 50_001)
    assert resp.status_code == 413
    detail = _error(resp)
    assert detail["code"] == "row_limit_exceeded"
    assert detail["details"]["max_rows"] == 50_000
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


def test_too_many_new_meters_is_a_structured_422_and_leaves_no_trace(client, test_db, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(entities, "MAX_AUTO_ENTITIES", 1)
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    text = HEADER + _row(building="b-a", meter="m-a") + _row(building="b-b", meter="m-b")
    resp = _post(client, text)
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    assert _error(resp)["code"] == "entity_limit_exceeded"
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


def test_out_of_range_timestamp_is_a_rejected_row_not_a_500(client):
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row(ts="0001-01-01T00:00:00+05:00") + _row())
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["invalid_timestamps"] == 1
    assert body["accepted_rows"] == 1


def test_all_rows_rejected_creates_no_entities(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row(ts="nope", building="b-z", meter="m-z"))
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert (body["accepted_rows"], body["meters_created"], body["buildings_created"]) == (0, 0, 0)
    after = _snapshot(test_db)
    for table in ("organizations", "buildings", "meters", "energy_readings"):
        assert after[table] == before[table]


def test_invalid_identifier_rows_are_counted_and_not_created(client, test_db):
    text = HEADER + _row() + _row(building="bad id!", meter="m-q", ts="2026-01-01T01:00:00Z")
    resp = _post(client, text)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["accepted_rows"] == 1
    assert body["invalid_ids"] == 1
    assert test_db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM buildings WHERE id = 'bad id!'").fetchone() is None
    assert test_db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM meters WHERE id = 'm-q'").fetchone() is None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- upload limits


def test_oversized_request_is_rejected_by_the_body_limit_before_parsing(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    big = "a" * (MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES + MULTIPART_OVERHEAD_BYTES + 1024)
    resp = _post(client, big)
    assert resp.status_code == 413
    assert _error(resp)["code"] == "request_too_large"
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


def test_file_just_over_the_limit_is_rejected_by_the_exact_file_check(client, test_db):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    resp = _post(client, "a" * (MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES + 1))
    assert resp.status_code == 413
    detail = _error(resp)
    assert detail["code"] == "file_too_large"
    assert detail["details"]["limit_bytes"] == MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- duplicates and conflicts


def test_importing_the_same_rows_under_a_new_batch_adds_nothing(client, test_db):
    text = HEADER + _row() + _row(ts="2026-01-01T01:00:00Z")
    assert _post(client, text, batch="ib-1").json()["accepted_rows"] == 2
    readings = _snapshot(test_db)["energy_readings"]
    again = _post(client, text, batch="ib-2").json()
    assert (again["accepted_rows"], again["duplicate_rows"]) == (0, 2)
    assert _snapshot(test_db)["energy_readings"] == readings


def test_batch_conflicts_have_codes_and_change_nothing(client, test_db):
    assert _post(client, HEADER + _row(), batch="ib-1").status_code == 200
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    same = _post(client, HEADER + _row(ts="2026-01-01T05:00:00Z"), batch="ib-1")
    assert same.status_code == 409
    assert _error(same)["code"] == "batch_already_imported"
    other = _post(client, HEADER + _row(ts="2026-01-01T05:00:00Z"), batch="ib-1", source="other")
    assert other.status_code == 409
    assert _error(other)["code"] == "batch_source_conflict"
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rollback on internal failure


def _failing_after_real_ingest(exc):
    real = imports_route.ingest_csv

    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        real(*args, **kwargs)  # rows, issues and entities are now written...
        raise exc  # ...then something fails before the import completes

    return wrapper


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("exc", "status", "code"),
    [
        (sqlite3.OperationalError("disk I/O error"), 500, "database_error"),
        (sqlite3.OperationalError("database is locked"), 503, "database_busy"),
        (RuntimeError("boom"), 500, "internal_error"),
    ],
)
def test_internal_failure_rolls_back_source_batch_entities_and_readings(
    client, test_db, monkeypatch, exc, status, code
):
    before = _snapshot(test_db)
    monkeypatch.setattr(imports_route, "ingest_csv", _failing_after_real_ingest(exc))
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row(building="b-new", meter="m-new"), source="src-new")
    assert resp.status_code == status
    detail = _error(resp)
    assert detail["code"] == code
    assert detail["rolled_back"] is True
    assert _snapshot(test_db) == before
    assert client.get("/api/v1/imports/ib-x").status_code == 404


def test_analysis_failure_after_commit_does_not_undo_the_import(client, test_db, monkeypatch):
    def boom(*_args, **_kwargs):
        raise sqlite3.Error("analysis exploded")

    monkeypatch.setattr(imports_route, "analyze_all", boom)
    resp = _post(client, HEADER + _row())
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["accepted_rows"] == 1
    # DEF-16: the caller can distinguish "no anomalies" from "analysis failed".
    assert body["analysis_failed"] is True
    assert body["import_committed"] is True
    assert _snapshot(test_db)["energy_readings"] == 1
    assert client.get("/api/v1/imports/ib-x").json()["status"] == "completed"

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb
"""End-to-end integration pass for EcoFac Part 2.1.

Covers the five user journeys (A-E), engineering validations, and
cross-feature invariants between the Decision Center and Scenario
Intelligence APIs. Every assertion reads from the live API, not from
internal helpers, so this file is the integration contract.
"""

import json
import sqlite3

import pytest

DECISIONS = "/api/v1/decisions"
SCENARIOS = "/api/v1/scenarios"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _decision_payload(
    *,
    it_value: float = 400.0,
    cool_value: float = 300.0,
    pue_value: float | None = 1.4,
    cap: float = 1000.0,
    cool_cap: float = 800.0,
    reserve: float = 0.10,
    quality: bool = True,
    quality_stale: bool = False,
    quality_flags: list[str] | None = None,
    proposed_it: float = 0.0,
    proposed_cool: float = 0.0,
    config_version: str = "cfg-1",
    it_timestamp: str = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    max_age: int | None = None,
) -> dict:
    decision = {
        "config": {
            "electrical": {"capacity": cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
            "cooling": {"capacity": cool_cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
        },
        "config_version": config_version,
        "it_load": {
            "name": "it_load",
            "value": it_value,
            "unit": "kW",
            "source": "MEASURED",
            "reference_id": "reading-it-1",
            "measurement_timestamp": it_timestamp,
        },
        "cooling_load": {
            "name": "cooling_load",
            "value": cool_value,
            "unit": "kW",
            "source": "MEASURED",
        },
        "proposed_it_delta": proposed_it,
        "proposed_cooling_delta": proposed_cool,
        "quality_eligible": quality,
        "quality_stale": quality_stale,
        "quality_flags": quality_flags or [],
        "uncertainty_flags": [],
        "conflicting_inputs": [],
        "mode": "hypothetical",
    }
    if pue_value is not None:
        decision["pue"] = {
            "name": "pue",
            "value": pue_value,
            "unit": "dimensionless",
            "source": "MEASURED",
        }
    if max_age is not None:
        decision["max_measurement_age_seconds"] = max_age
    return {"decision": decision}


def _scenario_payload(
    *,
    name: str = "s",
    it_load_kw: float = 400.0,
    cooling_load_kw: float = 300.0,
    pue: float = 1.4,
    cap: float = 1000.0,
    cool_cap: float = 800.0,
    reserve: float = 0.10,
    proposed_it: float = 0.0,
    proposed_cool: float = 0.0,
    config_version: str = "cfg-1",
) -> dict:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "config": {
            "electrical": {"capacity": cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
            "cooling": {"capacity": cool_cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
        },
        "config_version": config_version,
        "it_load_kw": it_load_kw,
        "cooling_load_kw": cooling_load_kw,
        "pue": pue,
        "proposed_it_delta_kw": proposed_it,
        "proposed_cooling_delta_kw": proposed_cool,
        "it_source": "ASSUMED",
        "cooling_source": "ASSUMED",
        "pue_source": "ASSUMED",
        "persist_as_decision": False,
    }


def _post_raw(client, url: str, payload: dict):
    """POST with allow_nan so infinity reaches the server validator."""
    raw = json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=True).encode("utf-8")
    return client.post(
        url, content=raw, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )


def _create_decision(client, **kwargs) -> str:
    resp = client.post(
        f"{DECISIONS}/evaluate", json=_decision_payload(**kwargs)
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    return resp.json()["decision_id"]


def _create_scenario(client, **kwargs) -> str:
    resp = client.post(f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=_scenario_payload(**kwargs))
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    return resp.json()["scenario_id"]


def _fetch_decision(client, decision_id: str) -> dict:
    resp = client.get(f"{DECISIONS}/{decision_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    return resp.json()


def _fetch_scenario(client, scenario_id: str) -> dict:
    resp = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}/{scenario_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    return resp.json()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Journey A: Decision Center full path
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_journey_a_decision_center_full_path(client):
    """Open Decision Center, list, select, inspect, verify."""
    # Seed two decisions so history is non-trivial
    id_approve = _create_decision(client, it_value=400.0, pue_value=1.4)
    id_reject = _create_decision(client, it_value=1100.0, pue_value=1.4)

    # List
    listing = client.get(f"{DECISIONS}?limit=10&offset=0")
    assert listing.status_code == 200
    assert listing.headers["X-Total-Count"] == "2"
    rows = listing.json()
    assert len(rows) == 2
    for row in rows:
        for key in ("id", "status", "precedence", "engine_version",
                    "config_version", "created_at", "decision_timestamp",
                    "supersedes", "is_superseded"):
            assert key in row, f"list missing {key}"

    # Select detail
    record = _fetch_decision(client, id_approve)
    assert record["status"] == "APPROVE"
    assert "request" in record
    assert "result" in record

    # Engineering inputs
    result = record["result"]
    inputs = result["evidence"]["calculation_inputs"]
    assert inputs["current_it_load_kw"] == 400.0
    assert inputs["current_facility_power_kw"] == 400.0 * 1.4
    assert inputs["pue"] == 1.4
    assert inputs["pue_provenance"] == "MEASURED"

    # Constraints
    constraints = result["state_machine_decision"]["evaluated_constraints"]
    names = [c["name"] for c in constraints]
    assert "electrical" in names
    assert "cooling" in names
    for c in constraints:
        for key in ("observed", "permitted", "physical_capacity",
                    "headroom_to_permitted", "headroom_to_physical",
                    "severity", "reason"):
            assert key in c

    # Evidence
    evidence = result["evidence"]
    assert "formulas" in evidence
    assert "assumptions" in evidence
    assert "constraints_snapshot" in evidence

    # Explanation and uncertainty
    assert result["explanation"]["summary"]
    assert result["explanation"]["limiting_constraint"] in ("electrical", "cooling")
    assert result["uncertainty"]["data_quality_level"]

    # Engineering summary
    eng = client.get(f"{DECISIONS}/{id_approve}/engineering")
    assert eng.status_code == 200
    eng_body = eng.json()
    assert eng_body["pue"] == 1.4
    assert eng_body["current_facility_power_kw"] == 560.0
    assert "headroom_to_permitted_kw" in eng_body["current_electrical"]

    # Verify
    verify = client.get(f"{DECISIONS}/{id_approve}/verify")
    assert verify.status_code == 200
    v = verify.json()
    assert v["verified"] is True
    assert v["output_verified"] is True
    assert v["verification_scope"] == "input_config_output_status"
    assert v["full_bundle_reproduced"] is False
    assert v["engine_version_match"] is True

    # Reject case is present too
    rec = _fetch_decision(client, id_reject)
    assert rec["status"] == "REJECT"
    assert rec["precedence"] == "hard_limit_violation"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Journey C: Multi-scenario comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_journey_c_multi_scenario_comparison(client):
    """Create 3 scenarios, compare, inspect differences."""
    id_a = _create_scenario(
        client, name="baseline", it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.0
    )
    id_b = _create_scenario(
        client, name="higher-it", it_load_kw=600.0, pue=1.0
    )
    id_c = _create_scenario(
        client, name="higher-pue", it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.4
    )

    resp = client.post(
        f"{SCENARIOS}/compare",
        json={"scenario_ids": [id_a, id_b, id_c]},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()

    assert len(body["scenarios"]) == 3
    statuses = [s["status"] for s in body["scenarios"]]
    assert all(s in ("APPROVE", "REJECT", "REVIEW") for s in statuses)

    # All scenarios record a most-restrictive constraint
    for s in body["scenarios"]:
        assert s["most_restrictive_constraint"] in ("electrical", "cooling")

    # input_differences flags it_load and pue
    diffs = {d["field_name"]: d for d in body["input_differences"]}
    assert diffs["it_load_kw"]["differs"] is True
    assert diffs["pue"]["differs"] is True
    assert diffs["electrical_capacity_kw"]["differs"] is False

    # No mixed configs (all created with default cfg-1)
    assert body["mixed_config_versions"] is False

    # Explanation names the differing inputs
    expl = body["outcome_explanation"]
    assert "it_load_kw" in expl


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Journey D: Invalid inputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_journey_d_invalid_inputs(client, test_db):
    """Reject invalid inputs and prove no records are persisted."""
    # Baseline: no scenarios or decisions exist yet
    assert test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM scenarios"
    ).fetchone()["c"] == 0
    assert test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM decisions"
    ).fetchone()["c"] == 0

    # --- 422 for Pydantic rejections ---
    neg = _scenario_payload()
    neg["it_load_kw"] = -1.0
    assert client.post(f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=neg).status_code == 422

    zero_pue = _scenario_payload(pue=0.0)
    assert client.post(
        f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=zero_pue
    ).status_code == 422

    neg_cap = _scenario_payload(cap=-100.0)
    assert client.post(
        f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=neg_cap
    ).status_code == 422

    reserve_one = _scenario_payload(reserve=1.0)
    assert client.post(
        f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=reserve_one
    ).status_code == 422

    empty_name = _scenario_payload(name="")
    assert client.post(
        f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=empty_name
    ).status_code == 422

    # --- 422: inf rejected by Pydantic allow_inf_nan=False ---
    inf_payload = _scenario_payload()
    inf_payload["it_load_kw"] = float("inf")
    resp = _post_raw(client, f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", inf_payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    detail = resp.json()["detail"]
    assert isinstance(detail, list)
    assert "finite" in str(detail).lower()

    # NaN fails Pydantic's gt=0 check -> 422. The response body must be
    # parseable JSON (before the server-side fix it crashed during
    # serialisation because JSONResponse disallows NaN).
    nan_payload = _scenario_payload()
    nan_payload["pue"] = float("nan")
    resp = _post_raw(client, f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", nan_payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    nan_body = resp.json()
    assert "detail" in nan_body

    # --- No records persisted ---
    assert test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM scenarios"
    ).fetchone()["c"] == 0
    assert test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM decisions"
    ).fetchone()["c"] == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Journey E: Missing evidence and stale measurements
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_journey_e_missing_evidence_and_stale(client, test_db):
    """Confirm REVIEW, stale reporting, and 422 for old records."""
    # Stale measurement: timestamp far in the past, max_age = 60s
    sid = _create_scenario(client, pue=1.0)
    # Update the scenario's stored timestamp by re-evaluating via decision
    # (scenarios use default max_age; use decision path for explicit stale)
    did_stale = _create_decision(
        client,
        it_timestamp="2020-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        max_age=60,
    )
    rec = _fetch_decision(client, did_stale)
    assert rec["status"] == "REVIEW"
    assert rec["precedence"] == "data_quality_ineligible"
    uncertainty = rec["result"]["uncertainty"]
    assert "it_load" in uncertainty["stale_measurements"]

    # Quality-ineligible -> REVIEW
    did_qual = _create_decision(
        client, quality=False, quality_flags=["missing_data"]
    )
    rec2 = _fetch_decision(client, did_qual)
    assert rec2["status"] == "REVIEW"
    assert rec2["precedence"] == "data_quality_ineligible"

    # Old scenario without PUE evidence -> 422
    test_db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO scenarios "
        "(id, name, created_at, status, precedence, engine_version, "
        "config_version, input_fingerprint, config_fingerprint, "
        "input_json, config_json, result_json, decision_id) "
        "VALUES ('old-1', 'legacy', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', "
        "'APPROVE', 'clean', '0.9', 'cfg-1', 'fp1', 'fp2', "
        "'{}', '{}', "
        "'{\"evidence\": {\"calculation_inputs\": {}}}', NULL)"
    )
    eng = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}/old-1/engineering")
    assert eng.status_code == 422
    assert "predates" in eng.json()["detail"]

    # Base record still retrievable; only engineering is missing
    base = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}/old-1")
    assert base.status_code == 200
    assert base.json()["status"] == "APPROVE"

    _ = sid  # sanity: created scenario exists


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Regression: NaN/inf must not crash the error-response serialiser
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_nan_returns_clean_422_not_server_crash(client, test_db):
    """Regression: NaN in a Pydantic-validated field returns clean JSON 422."""
    before_scenarios = test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM scenarios"
    ).fetchone()["c"]
    before_decisions = test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM decisions"
    ).fetchone()["c"]

    for field in ("pue", "it_load_kw", "cooling_load_kw"):
        payload = _scenario_payload()
        payload[field] = float("nan")
        resp = _post_raw(client, f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", payload)
        # Server must answer cleanly (before the fix, this raised a 500)
        assert resp.status_code in (400, 422), (
            f"{field}=nan returned {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        )
        # Body must be parseable JSON with a detail field
        body = resp.json()
        assert "detail" in body

    # No rows leaked through the error path
    assert test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM scenarios"
    ).fetchone()["c"] == before_scenarios
    assert test_db.execute(
        "SELECT count(*) AS c FROM decisions"
    ).fetchone()["c"] == before_decisions


def test_inf_returns_clean_400_not_server_crash(client):
    """inf passes Pydantic gt=0 but is caught by validate_scenario_numerics."""
    payload = _scenario_payload()
    payload["it_load_kw"] = float("inf")
    resp = _post_raw(client, f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    body = resp.json()
    # 422 detail is a list of Pydantic error dicts, not a string.
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert "finite" in str(body["detail"]).lower()

def test_engineering_pue_multiplies_facility_power(client):
    """Facility power = IT load * PUE, exactly."""
    id_a = _create_scenario(
        client, it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.0, cap=1000.0
    )
    id_b = _create_scenario(
        client, it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.4, cap=1000.0
    )
    eng_a = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}/{id_a}/engineering").json()
    eng_b = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}/{id_b}/engineering").json()
    assert eng_a["current_facility_power_kw"] == 400.0
    assert eng_b["current_facility_power_kw"] == 400.0 * 1.4


def test_engineering_facility_power_not_it_load_for_constraint(client):
    """The electrical constraint compares facility power, not raw IT load."""
    # IT load 400 (would pass IT-only), PUE 1.4 -> facility 560 > cap 500
    sid = _create_scenario(
        client, it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.4, cap=500.0
    )
    record = _fetch_scenario(client, sid)
    assert record["status"] == "REJECT"
    assert record["precedence"] == "hard_limit_violation"

    constraints = record["result"]["state_machine_decision"]["evaluated_constraints"]
    elecs = [c for c in constraints if c["name"] == "electrical"]
    assert any(c["severity"] == "PHYSICAL_VIOLATION" for c in elecs)
    # The observed value is facility power, not IT load
    assert any(abs(c["observed"] - 560.0) < 0.01 for c in elecs)


def test_engineering_reserve_reduces_permitted(client):
    """Reserve reduces the permitted limit below physical capacity."""
    sid = _create_scenario(
        client, it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.0, cap=1000.0, reserve=0.10
    )
    eng = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}/{sid}/engineering").json()
    elec = eng["current_electrical"]
    assert elec["physical_capacity_kw"] == 1000.0
    assert elec["permitted_kw"] == 900.0
    assert elec["headroom_to_permitted_kw"] == 500.0
    assert elec["headroom_to_physical_kw"] == 600.0


def test_engineering_cooling_independent(client):
    """Cooling constraint is independent of electrical."""
    # Electrical fine but cooling violated
    sid = _create_scenario(
        client,
        it_load_kw=400.0,
        pue=1.0,
        cap=1000.0,
        cooling_load_kw=900.0,
        cool_cap=800.0,
    )
    record = _fetch_scenario(client, sid)
    assert record["status"] == "REJECT"
    constraints = record["result"]["state_machine_decision"]["evaluated_constraints"]
    cools = [c for c in constraints if c["name"] == "cooling"]
    elecs = [c for c in constraints if c["name"] == "electrical"]
    assert any(c["severity"] == "PHYSICAL_VIOLATION" for c in cools)
    assert all(c["severity"] == "OK" for c in elecs)


def test_engineering_negative_predicted_load(client):
    """Negative predicted load is classified, not silently clamped."""
    sid = _create_scenario(
        client, it_load_kw=400.0, proposed_it=-500.0, pue=1.0
    )
    record = _fetch_scenario(client, sid)
    assert record["status"] == "REJECT"
    assert record["precedence"] == "invalid_proposal"
    reasons = record["result"]["evidence"]["calculation_inputs"][
        "invalid_proposal_reasons"
    ]
    assert reasons
    assert "negative" in reasons[0].lower()


def test_engineering_unit_conversion_rejected(client):
    """Only canonical units (kW / dimensionless) are accepted."""
    # Reasonable PUE value but wrong unit ("kW" instead of "dimensionless")
    bad_payload = _decision_payload()
    bad_payload["decision"]["pue"] = {
        "name": "pue",
        "value": 1.4,
        "unit": "kW",
        "source": "MEASURED",
    }
    resp = client.post(f"{DECISIONS}/evaluate", json=bad_payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert "dimensionless" in resp.json()["detail"].lower()


def test_engineering_missing_tolerance_unknown_uncertainty(client):
    """Measured without tolerance -> model uncertainty UNKNOWN."""
    sid = _create_scenario(client, it_load_kw=400.0, pue=1.0)
    record = _fetch_scenario(client, sid)
    assert record["result"]["uncertainty"]["model_uncertainty_level"] == "UNKNOWN"


def test_engineering_existing_overload_with_corrective_action(client):
    """Default behaviour: current overload blocks repair.

    ``corrective_action_mode`` is exposed via the API (default False).
    When False, a proposal that repairs an existing overload is still
    rejected, because both current and predicted states are evaluated.
    Set the flag to True to accept the repair (DEF-19).
    """
    sid = _create_scenario(
        client,
        it_load_kw=1100.0,
        proposed_it=-300.0,
        pue=1.0,
        cap=1000.0,
    )
    record = _fetch_scenario(client, sid)
    # Predicted is fine (1100 - 300 = 800 < 900) but current is overloaded
    assert record["status"] == "REJECT"
    assert record["precedence"] == "hard_limit_violation"

def test_scenario_can_bridge_to_decision_history(client):
    """persist_as_decision=true creates both rows and links them."""
    payload = _scenario_payload(name="bridge-test", pue=1.4)
    payload["persist_as_decision"] = True
    resp = client.post(f"{SCENARIOS}/evaluate", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["decision_id"] is not None

    # Decision exists in decisions table
    record = _fetch_decision(client, body["decision_id"])
    assert record["status"] == body["result"]["status"]

    # Scenario references it
    scenario = _fetch_scenario(client, body["scenario_id"])
    assert scenario["decision_id"] == body["decision_id"]


def test_decisions_and_scenarios_are_independent_streams(client):
    """By default scenarios do not pollute decision history."""
    _create_decision(client)
    _create_scenario(client)
    _create_scenario(client)

    decisions = client.get(f"{DECISIONS}").json()
    scenarios = client.get(f"{SCENARIOS}").json()
    assert len(decisions) == 1
    assert len(scenarios) == 2


def test_append_only_enforced_for_both_tables(client, test_db):
    """Both decisions and scenarios reject UPDATE/DELETE."""
    did = _create_decision(client)
    sid = _create_scenario(client)
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError, match="append-only"):
        test_db.execute(
            "UPDATE decisions SET status = 'REJECT' WHERE id = ?", (did,)
        )
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError, match="append-only"):
        test_db.execute(
            "UPDATE scenarios SET name = 'tampered' WHERE id = ?", (sid,)
        )
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError, match="append-only"):
        test_db.execute("DELETE FROM decisions WHERE id = ?", (did,))
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError, match="append-only"):
        test_db.execute("DELETE FROM scenarios WHERE id = ?", (sid,))

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb
"""End-to-end tests for rate-limit middleware (opt-in via env)."""

import pytest

from ecofac.api.rate_limit import (
    get_rate_limiter,
    is_rate_limit_enabled,
    reset_rate_limiter,
)


@pytest.fixture
def enabled_limiter(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("ECOFAC_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED", "true")
    limiter = get_rate_limiter()
    saved_read = limiter.read_limit
    saved_write = limiter.write_limit
    limiter.read_limit = 3
    limiter.write_limit = 2
    reset_rate_limiter()
    try:
        yield limiter
    finally:
        limiter.read_limit = saved_read
        limiter.write_limit = saved_write
        reset_rate_limiter()


def test_rate_limit_enabled_by_default(monkeypatch):
    """DEF-20: rate limiting is on unless explicitly disabled."""
    monkeypatch.delenv("ECOFAC_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED", raising=False)
    assert is_rate_limit_enabled() is True


def test_rate_limit_can_be_disabled(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("ECOFAC_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED", "false")
    assert is_rate_limit_enabled() is False


def test_small_burst_passes_under_default_limits(client):
    """Default 600 reads/min: a small burst must not be limited."""
    for _ in range(5):
        assert client.get("/health").status_code == 200


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("enabled_limiter")
def test_rate_limit_blocks_after_threshold(client):
    headers = {"X-Forwarded-For": "198.51.100.42"}
    codes = [client.get("/health", headers=headers).status_code for _ in range(5)]
    assert codes[:3] == [200, 200, 200]
    assert codes[3] == 429
    assert codes[4] == 429


def test_rate_limit_returns_retry_after(client, enabled_limiter):
    enabled_limiter.read_limit = 1
    headers = {"X-Forwarded-For": "198.51.100.99"}
    client.get("/health", headers=headers)
    resp = client.get("/health", headers=headers)
    assert resp.status_code == 429
    assert "Retry-After" in resp.headers
    assert int(resp.headers["Retry-After"]) >= 1


def test_429_still_has_security_headers(client, enabled_limiter):
    enabled_limiter.read_limit = 1
    headers = {"X-Forwarded-For": "198.51.100.55"}
    client.get("/health", headers=headers)
    resp = client.get("/health", headers=headers)
    assert resp.status_code == 429
    assert resp.headers.get("X-Content-Type-Options") == "nosniff"
    assert "X-Request-ID" in resp.headers

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb

"""Regression tests for specific API bugs."""

def test_new_source_id_is_auto_created(client):
    """Uploading a file with an unknown source ID should auto-create it and succeed."""
    csv_content = (
        "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n"
        "2026-01-01T12:00:00Z,b1,m1,10.5,kWh\n"
    )
    files = {"file": ("test.csv", csv_content, "text/csv")}
    data = {"source_id": "new-source", "batch_id": "ib1"}

    response = client.post("/api/v1/imports", files=files, data=data)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["accepted_rows"] == 1

def test_quality_rejects_naive_timestamps(client):
    """Naive start/end params must produce a 400, not a 500."""
    response = client.get(
        "/api/v1/quality/m1",
        params={"start": "2026-01-01T00:00:00", "end": "2026-01-02T00:00:00"},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400

def test_csv_naive_timestamp_rejected_via_http(client):
    """CSV rows with naive timestamps are rejected with a counter."""
    csv_content = (
        "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n"
        "2026-01-01T12:00:00,b1,m1,10.5,kWh\n"
    )
    files = {"file": ("n.csv", csv_content, "text/csv")}
    data = {"source_id": "s1", "batch_id": "ib-naive"}
    resp = client.post("/api/v1/imports", files=files, data=data)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["accepted_rows"] == 0

def test_full_incident_lifecycle_via_http(client):
    """DETECTED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> RESOLVED over HTTP."""
    flat = "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n" + "".join(
        f"2026-01-01T{h:02d}:00:00Z,b1,m1,10.0,kWh\n" for h in range(24)
    )
    resp = client.post(
        "/api/v1/imports",
        files={"file": ("flat.csv", flat, "text/csv")},
        data={"source_id": "s1", "batch_id": "ib-flat"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200

    spike = (
        "timestamp,building_id,meter_id,energy_value,unit\n"
        "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z,b1,m1,100.0,kWh\n"
    )
    resp = client.post(
        "/api/v1/imports",
        files={"file": ("spike.csv", spike, "text/csv")},
        data={"source_id": "s1", "batch_id": "ib-spike"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200

    resp = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze/m1", params={"timestamp": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"}
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["status"] == "anomalies_detected"
    finding = body["findings"][0]
    assert finding["gated_by_quality"] is False

    incident_id = finding["incident_id"]

    # 1. Transition DETECTED -> UNDER_REVIEW
    resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/review", json={"reason": "Investigating"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["status"] == "UNDER_REVIEW"

    # 2. Transition UNDER_REVIEW -> ACKNOWLEDGED
    resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/acknowledge", json={"reason": "Confirmed"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["status"] == "ACKNOWLEDGED"

    # 3. Transition ACKNOWLEDGED -> RESOLVED
    resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/resolve", json={"reason": "Fixed"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["status"] == "RESOLVED"

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb
"""Scenario Intelligence analysis endpoints."""

BASE = "/api/v1/scenarios"


def _body(
    *,
    name="baseline",
    it_load_kw=400.0,
    cooling_load_kw=300.0,
    pue=1.0,
    proposed_it_delta_kw=0.0,
    proposed_cooling_delta_kw=0.0,
    cap=1000.0,
    cool_cap=800.0,
    reserve=0.10,
    config_version="cfg-1",
):
    return {
        "name": name,
        "config": {
            "electrical": {"capacity": cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
            "cooling": {"capacity": cool_cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
        },
        "config_version": config_version,
        "it_load_kw": it_load_kw,
        "cooling_load_kw": cooling_load_kw,
        "pue": pue,
        "proposed_it_delta_kw": proposed_it_delta_kw,
        "proposed_cooling_delta_kw": proposed_cooling_delta_kw,
        "it_source": "ASSUMED",
        "cooling_source": "ASSUMED",
        "pue_source": "ASSUMED",
        "persist_as_decision": False,
    }


def _create(client, **kwargs):
    resp = client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=_body(**kwargs))
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    return resp.json()["scenario_id"]

import json
import sqlite3

import pytest

from ecofac.decision.limits import (
    ConstraintConfig,
    CoolingLimits,
    ElectricalLimits,
)
from ecofac.decision.measurements import (
    MeasurementSource,
    RichMeasurement,
)
from ecofac.decision.scenarios import evaluate_and_persist_scenario
from ecofac.decision.transparent import TransparentDecisionRequest

BASE = "/api/v1/scenarios"


def _body(
    *,
    name="baseline",
    it_load_kw=400.0,
    cooling_load_kw=300.0,
    pue=1.0,
    proposed_it_delta_kw=0.0,
    proposed_cooling_delta_kw=0.0,
    cap=1000.0,
    cool_cap=800.0,
    reserve=0.10,
    config_version="cfg-1",
    persist_as_decision=False,
    it_source="ASSUMED",
    cooling_source="ASSUMED",
    pue_source="ASSUMED",
):
    return {
        "name": name,
        "config": {
            "electrical": {"capacity": cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
            "cooling": {"capacity": cool_cap, "reserve_pct": reserve},
        },
        "config_version": config_version,
        "it_load_kw": it_load_kw,
        "cooling_load_kw": cooling_load_kw,
        "pue": pue,
        "proposed_it_delta_kw": proposed_it_delta_kw,
        "proposed_cooling_delta_kw": proposed_cooling_delta_kw,
        "it_source": it_source,
        "cooling_source": cooling_source,
        "pue_source": pue_source,
        "persist_as_decision": persist_as_decision,
    }


def _post(client, **kwargs):
    return client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=_body(**kwargs))


def _post_raw(client, payload):
    """Send raw JSON so allow_nan=True can serialize Infinity/NaN."""
    raw = json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=True).encode("utf-8")
    return client.post(
        f"{BASE}/evaluate",
        content=raw,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )

def test_append_only_scenarios(client, test_db):
    scenario_id = _post(client).json()["scenario_id"]
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError, match="append-only"):
        test_db.execute(
            "UPDATE scenarios SET name = 'tampered' WHERE id = ?",
            (scenario_id,),
        )
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError, match="append-only"):
        test_db.execute(
            "DELETE FROM scenarios WHERE id = ?", (scenario_id,)
        )


def test_persist_scenario_pins_evaluation_time(test_db):
    """Time-dependent scenarios must pin evaluation_time in stored inputs."""
    req = TransparentDecisionRequest(
        config=ConstraintConfig(
            electrical=ElectricalLimits(capacity=1000.0, reserve_pct=0.10),
            cooling=CoolingLimits(capacity=800.0, reserve_pct=0.10),
        ),
        config_version="cfg-1",
        it_load=RichMeasurement(
            name="it_load", value=400.0, unit="kW",
            source=MeasurementSource.ASSUMED,
        ),
        cooling_load=RichMeasurement(
            name="cooling_load", value=300.0, unit="kW",
            source=MeasurementSource.ASSUMED,
        ),
        pue=RichMeasurement(
            name="pue", value=1.4, unit="dimensionless",
            source=MeasurementSource.ASSUMED,
        ),
        quality_eligible=True,
        max_measurement_age_seconds=3600,  # makes the request time-dependent
    )
    sid, _, result = evaluate_and_persist_scenario(
        test_db, name="time-pinned", transparent_request=req,
        persist_as_decision=False,
    )
    row = test_db.execute(
        "SELECT input_json FROM scenarios WHERE id = ?", (sid,)
    ).fetchone()
    inputs = json.loads(row["input_json"])
    assert "evaluation_time" in inputs
    assert inputs["evaluation_time"] == result.evaluation_time


def test_scenario_corrective_action_mode(client):

    payload = _body(
        it_load_kw=1100.0,

        cap=1000.0,
    )
    payload["corrective_action_mode"] = True
    resp = client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["result"]["status"] == "APPROVE"


def test_verify_scenario_evidence_bundle_matches(client):
    """A fresh scenario's evidence bundle reproduces with the correct version."""
    scenario_id = _post(client).json()["scenario_id"]
    body = client.get(f"{BASE}/{scenario_id}/verify").json()
    assert body["evidence_bundle_verified"] is True
    assert body["evidence_bundle_diff"] is None

def test_scenarios_page_consumes_backend_for_all_engineering_values(client):
    """Every engineering outcome comes from the backend, not from JS math.

    The previous version of this test asserted ``"/engineering" not in html``,
    which contradicted its own name and would fail on a legitimate link.
    This version asserts the two properties that actually matter:
    (1) the page consumes the backend endpoints that pre-compute values;
    (2) the page does not recompute the primary engineering formulas.
    """
    resp = client.get("/scenarios")
    html = resp.text

    # (1) Backend endpoints the page must consume.
    for endpoint in (
        "/api/v1/scenarios/evaluate",
        "/api/v1/scenarios/compare",
        "/bottlenecks",
        "/sensitivity",
    ):
        assert endpoint in html, f"page must consume {endpoint}"

    # (2) No client-side recomputation of the primary formulas.
    # Display-only percentages for progress bars are permitted.
    for forbidden in ("* pue", "pue * ", "ev.permitted - ev.observed"):
        assert forbidden not in html, (
            f"page must not compute engineering values in JS: {forbidden!r}"
        )

# Copyright 2026 Lightibulb
"""Trusted decision path over HTTP: no mixing of trusted and caller inputs."""

import datetime as dt
import json

import pytest

BASE = "/api/v1/decisions"
INTERVAL = 30


def z(ts: dt.datetime) -> str:
    return ts.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def slot(*, offset_minutes: int = 0) -> dt.datetime:
    """The most recent completed 30-minute slot, shifted by ``offset_minutes``."""
    now = dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC)
    floored = now.replace(minute=(now.minute // INTERVAL) * INTERVAL, second=0, microsecond=0)
    return floored - dt.timedelta(minutes=INTERVAL) + dt.timedelta(minutes=offset_minutes)


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _default_policy(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("ECOFAC_TRUSTED_MAX_AGE_SECONDS", raising=False)


def seed(db, *, ts=None, it_role="IT_LOAD", cool_role="COOLING",
         it_tol=0.02, cool_tol=0.03, interval=INTERVAL, with_prev=True):
    ts = ts or slot()
    db.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO import_batches (id, source_id, status, imported_at) "
        "VALUES ('ib1','s1','started','2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')"
    )
    for meter, role, tol in (("it-m", it_role, it_tol), ("cool-m", cool_role, cool_tol)):
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO meters (id, building_id, fuel_type, unit, interval_minutes, "
            "role, relative_tolerance, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, 'b1', 'electricity', 'kWh', ?, ?, ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')",
            (meter, interval, role, tol),
        )
    stamps = [ts - dt.timedelta(minutes=interval), ts] if with_prev else [ts]
    for meter, kwh in (("it-m", 200.0), ("cool-m", 150.0)):  # 400 kW / 300 kW
        for t in stamps:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO energy_readings (id, meter_id, timestamp_utc, value, unit, "
                "source_id, batch_id, is_valid, created_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'kWh', 's1', 'ib1', 1, ?)",
                (f"{meter}@{z(t)}", meter, z(t), kwh, z(t)),
            )
    return ts


def decision(ts, *, it_ref=True, cool_ref=True, pue="configured", **overrides):
    it = {
        "name": "it_load", "value": 1.0, "unit": "kW", "source": "ESTIMATED",
        "uncertainty": {"absolute_tolerance": 0.0001},  # caller lies about accuracy
    }
    cool = {"name": "cooling_load", "value": 1.0, "unit": "kW", "source": "ESTIMATED"}
    if it_ref:
        it.update(meter_id="it-m", measurement_timestamp=z(ts))
    if cool_ref:
        cool.update(meter_id="cool-m", measurement_timestamp=z(ts))
    body = {
        "config": {
            "electrical": {"capacity": 1000.0, "reserve_pct": 0.10},
            "cooling": {"capacity": 800.0, "reserve_pct": 0.10},
        },
        "config_version": "cfg-1",
        "it_load": it,
        "cooling_load": cool,
        "proposed_it_delta": 0.0,
        "proposed_cooling_delta": 0.0,
        "quality_eligible": True,
        "quality_stale": False,
        "uncertainty_flags": [],
        "conflicting_inputs": [],
        "mode": "trusted",
    }
    if pue == "configured":
        body["pue"] = {"name": "pue", "value": 1.4, "unit": "dimensionless",
                       "source": "CONFIGURED"}
    elif pue == "measured":
        body["pue"] = {"name": "pue", "value": 1.4, "unit": "dimensionless",
                       "source": "MEASURED"}
    body.update(overrides)
    return {"decision": body}


def post(client, payload):
    return client.post(f"{BASE}/evaluate", json=payload)


def applied_flags(resp):
    inputs = resp.json()["result"]["evidence"]["calculation_inputs"]
    return "; ".join(inputs["applied_uncertainty_flags"])


# ---- the happy path and energy/power semantics ------------------------------

def test_trusted_path_converts_energy_to_power_and_preserves_the_raw_reading(client, test_db):
    ts = seed(test_db)
    resp = post(client, decision(ts))
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    result = resp.json()["result"]
    assert result["status"] == "APPROVE"
    inputs = result["evidence"]["calculation_inputs"]
    assert inputs["current_it_load_kw"] == pytest.approx(400.0)
    assert inputs["current_cooling_load_kw"] == pytest.approx(300.0)
    it_ref = next(r for r in result["evidence"]["input_references"] if r["name"] == "it_load")
    assert it_ref["value"] == pytest.approx(400.0)
    assert it_ref["unit"] == "kW"
    assert it_ref["raw_value"] == 200.0
    assert it_ref["raw_unit"] == "kWh"
    assert it_ref["interval_minutes"] == INTERVAL
    assert it_ref["source"] == "MEASURED"


def test_fifteen_minute_meters_are_not_read_as_hourly(client, test_db):
    ts = seed(test_db, interval=15)
    resp = post(client, decision(ts))
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    # 200 kWh in 15 minutes is 800 kW average, not 200 or 400.
    inputs = resp.json()["result"]["evidence"]["calculation_inputs"]
    assert inputs["current_it_load_kw"] == pytest.approx(800.0)


# ---- partial trust / missing references / alignment -------------------------

def test_partial_trust_is_rejected(client, test_db):
    ts = seed(test_db)
    resp = post(client, decision(ts, cool_ref=False))
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert "cooling_load" in resp.json()["detail"]


def test_no_references_is_rejected(client, test_db):
    ts = seed(test_db)
    assert post(client, decision(ts, it_ref=False, cool_ref=False)).status_code == 400


def test_mismatched_timestamps_are_rejected(client, test_db):
    ts = seed(test_db)
    payload = decision(ts)
    payload["decision"]["cooling_load"]["measurement_timestamp"] = z(
        ts - dt.timedelta(minutes=INTERVAL)
    )
    resp = post(client, payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert "not aligned" in resp.json()["detail"]


def test_future_timestamp_is_rejected(client, test_db):
    ts = seed(test_db, ts=slot(offset_minutes=180))
    resp = post(client, decision(ts))
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert "future" in resp.json()["detail"]
